jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Lifehouse is looking for an organized, people-focused Program Coordinator to support our Director of Programs and Operations, Marin Supported Living Services (SLS) team, and Quality Assurance team. This is a varied role that combines program coordination, intake, documentation, quality assurance, and office support.

What you will do:

* Support the intake process, including gathering information, conducting interviews with individuals and families, and preparing assessments
* Provide administrative and program support to the Director of Programs and Operations and Marin Supported Living Services team
* Maintain Individual Service Plan (ISP) records, program databases, tracking systems, and other required documentation
* Coordinate and track required program documentation and follow up with staff to ensure records are complete and timely
* Support Quality Assurance activities, training records, and audit preparation
* Coordinate meetings, communications, events, and program materials

What you will bring:

* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent attention to detail and follow-through
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
* Professional, collaborative, and people-focused approach
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Adobe
* At least two years of experience in program coordination, administrative support, human services, social services, or a related field
* Experience with interviews, assessments, or reports is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; nonprofit or human services experience a plus
* Valid California driver’s license, reliable vehicle, and ability to travel locally

Why you would want to join us:

* Competitive Pay: Up to $36.00 per hour
* Make a difference supporting people with developmental disabilities
* Enjoy variety with a role that touches programs, intake, Quality Assurance, and office operations
* Be part of a supportive team in a collaborative, mission-driven organization
* Build your skills across program coordination and nonprofit operations
* Compensation and Benefits
* Full-time, in-person role
* Competitive pay based on experience
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with matching
* Paid time off
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee assistance program

What are you waiting for? Apply today! Join us today and make a difference!

Lifehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Employee Engagement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco/San Jose/Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

We’ve built a lot of great resources for employees: onboarding guides, benefits pages, manager how-tos, and hiring FAQs. But we move faster than we document and maintain. We’re growing quickly. Things get out of date, hard to find, or inconsistent in tone. We need someone to own that problem end to end and make sure every piece of employee-facing content is accurate, easy to find, and sounds like it came from the same team.

This isn’t a pure technical writing role, and it isn’t a traditional program management role either. It’s both. You’ll write, design, and edit, but you’ll also audit, organize, and measure. If you like bringing order to scattered information and quietly making everyone’s job a little easier (maybe even delightful), this is your gig.

**What You’ll Do**

* Audit employee-facing pages, websites, FAQs, guides, and policies.
* Write and edit onboarding guides, templates, FAQs, and how-tos.
* Set consistent tone, voice, and format across content.
* Organize content so employees can find answers.
* Fix pages and processes when something isn't working.
* Track usage and feedback to see what’s working and what isn’t.
* Coordinate with HR, Talent, on shared content.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years in writing, content, or program coordination.
* Strong, clear, creative writing and editing skills.
* Comfort building style guides and content standards.
* A sharp eye for content that’s outdated or hard to find.
* Comfort tracking metrics like page views, clicks, comments, reactions.
* Nice to have: experience with Notion, Confluence, Wikis.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

You’ll have a front-row seat to the growth of a company shaping the future of tech, and you’ll have a direct hand in making that growth possible. We value speed, tenacity, creativity, and being excellent to each other. You’ll be a part of the Employee Engagement team. Our goal is simple: to be the most helpful team at Lambda. If you want a seat where you can make a huge impact every day and turn chaos into clarity, this is it.

**Salary Range Information**

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

**About Lambda**

* Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
* Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
* We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
* Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
* We offer generous cash & equity compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
* 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
* Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

Compensation Range: $135K - $180K

jobs.title: Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250
jobs.description:
Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Graduate Funding Unit plays a central role in maintaining the highest level of academic excellence possible at UC Berkeley. We provide fellowships, funding, and program support to attract the most competitive students to our university and provide funding opportunities for students at various stages of their academic career. Our programs exist to give students opportunities to devote themselves fully to the pursuit of their scholarly and professional interests. Our knowledge and expertise in all areas of graduate funding and student life provide a strong foundation for advising the students, faculty, and staff across our vast and diverse campus.
  
  
The Student Funding team trains and advises staff and faculty departmental advisors in over 125 degree programs, offers direct advising to approximately 13,000 graduate and professional students, as well as individuals seeking admission into a graduate program at Berkeley. Training and expertise includes fellowship and academic support funding and collective bargaining agreement administration for academic student employees and graduate student researchers.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Fellowships Program Coordinator plays a significant role in supporting graduate students through the administration of Graduate Division, Campus, National, and International fellowship programs on behalf of the campus. This position works with internal and external organizations to coordinate graduate student fellowships, providing support to students, faculty, and staff from application to evaluation to awarding. The Fellowships Program Coordinator serves as an expert resource to update formulas and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies, ensuring proper payment of awards and monitoring compliance with fellowship terms. Additionally, this position administers and tracks the current University Fellowship allocation system, analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery, and partners with departmental staff to provide accurate and transparent information about funding to help students achieve their academic goals.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 19, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 30%
  
  
Implements and coordinates graduate student fellowship programs administered by the Graduate Division.
  
Works with internal and external organizations to coordinate procedures.
  
Serves as expert resource to update applications and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies.
  
Analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
  
NSF GRFP Administration - 30%
  
  
Serves as campus-wide expert and steward of National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program (NSF GRFP).
  
Acts as student facing Coordinating Official, working with fellows, faculty, and staff to provide information, respond to inquiries about program policies, and interface with the NSF.
  
Interprets regulations and develops or recommends procedures to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
Reconciles large volumes of student data from multiple sources and adjusts Grants Roster Report. Coordinates yearly NSF GRFP info session.
  
Updates NSF GRFP Administration at UCB guide.
  
Works with fellows, GSAOs, and Berkeley Regional Services to ensure correct assessment and funding source.
  
  
Travel Grant Administration - 10%
  
  
Reviews Slate fellowship application data to administer the Graduate Division's Conference Travel Grant program.
  
Monitors, tracks, and makes awards in Campus Solutions.
  
Tracks budget and provides analysis of usage and suggestions on how to improve the process.
  
Provides individual counseling on non-routine, sensitive aid issues.
  
Exercises professional judgment to authorize changes in financial aid awards.
  
  
Fellowship and Block Grant Allocations - 10%
  
  
Provides annual Berkeley and Chancellor's Fellowship allocation information to divisional leadership and tracks their departmental allocations.
  
Monitors and tracks Chancellor's carry forward and other exceptions.
  
Delivers annual Block Grant memos to programs.
  
Memos provide yearly allocation amounts as well as Graduate Opportunity Program, Mentored Research Award, and UC Dissertation Year nomination amounts.
  
Recommends new or changes to policy in areas needing clarification, and supports the Director of Student Funding to identify solutions to existing fellowship program policies without precedent.

##### **Job Type: Full Time**

##### **Job Category: IT**

#### **Job Description**

Supply Chain Program Manager

San Jose, CA (Onsite)

FTE Only

  
  

**Job Description**

**Must Have Technical/Functional Skills**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree and 5–7+ years of professional experience in Supply Chain

and Cost Management or an equivalent field.

* Cost Management Expertise: Proven experience with cost avoidance, cost reduction, and value engineering.

* BOM Proficiency: Deep expertise in understanding, analyzing, and managing product Bills of Material (BOM)

and costing structures.

* Problem-Solving: Strong capability in root cause analysis and complex problem-solving within a technical

environment.

* Interpersonal Skills: Effective communication and interpersonal skills required to collaborate with

engineering and manufacturing teams in an interactive, global environment.

Ex-Cisco Supply Chain experience will be preferred

**Responsibilities:**

As a Supply Chain Program Manager, you will serve as the primary driver for supply chain readiness,

total cost management, and BOM resiliency for all hardware programs from pre-concept through

First Hardware Ship (FHS), holding accountability for the assigned product portfolio’s total cost and

margin management, cost reduction programs, and risk mitigation. You will validate the integrity of

costed BOMs and forward costing to articulate main cost drivers, support standard and gross margin

management through value engineering, commodity analysis, and BOM optimization, and lead ramp

plans to ensure continuity of material supply and delivery between prototype and early production

phases. Well versed in Should cost modeling, NPI cost Management, Award Optimization,

Quarterly Price Negotiation and Bridge Buys, Margin Management and BOM Health Index WRT Cost,

Preferred Qualifications:

* Manufacturing Excellence: Experience in manufacturing and process improvements to drive cost-down

* Systems Knowledge: Knowledge of PLM processes and experience with the Agile PDM system.

* Analytical & Presentation Skills: Advanced analytical capabilities and strong presentation skills to

communicate effectively with stakeholders.

* Communication: Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

* Organizational Skills: Efficient organizational and multi-tasking abilities to manage multiple high-priority

projects simultaneously.

* Industry Trends: Knowledge and application of industry innovations and trends as they relate to product

or program development.

jobs.title: Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Sequoia Difference**

At Sequoia Home Health and Hospice, we’re passionate about our work and take pride in the quality of service we provide. Our community is uniquely diverse, and it’s our aim to fulfill the unique needs of our patients through excellent individualized care.

Our focus is to help facilitate a smooth and safe transition home and provide life-changing service with the amount of care and dignity our patients and their families deserve.

**Sequoia is growing and looking for experienced, compassionate Intake Coordinator to join our team!**

**SUMMARY**

The Intake Coordinator is responsible for managing all aspects of the patient intake process including communicating directly with patients and families, data entry, establishing and maintaining positive relationships with customers and referral sources, responding to customer requests and concerns, facilitating a daily intake stand up meeting, and managing the insurance verification and authorization processes.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The Intake Coordinator directs all daily patient referral and intake operations including providing direct oversight of the establishment and implementation of intake policies.
* Directs the implementation of improved work methods and procedures to ensure patients are admitted in accordance with policy.
* Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with current and potential referral sources.
* Ensures seamless transition of patients to home care by providing direct oversight of patient education and preparation for home care, plan of care initiation, and coordination of care with multiple service providers.
* Ensures maximum third party reimbursement through direct oversight of insurance verification and authorization processes.
* Maintains comprehensive working knowledge of Home Health contractual relationships and ensures that patients are admitted according to contract provisions.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* The Intake Coordinator must have healthcare experience, preferably in referrals/intake in a home health environment.
* A nursing background is preferred but not required.
* Demonstrates good communication, negotiation, and public relations skills.
* Demonstrates autonomy, assertiveness, flexibility and cooperation in performing job responsibilities.

**Why Sequoia Home Health?**

Sequoia Home Health **is part of the Cornerstone/Pennant Group** with close to 80 locations throughout the country. **While we are part of a large family, we operate as a local team.** We understand we are nothing without great employees! It is through our team’s dedication to deliver life changing service that we become the “provider of choice” in the community that we serve. **Join a culture of high performers** who are on a mission to create the best Home Health and Hospice agency in the Bay Area!

**What makes us unique** besides our culture of high performers and exceptional care? At Sequoia Home Health, we foster an environment where clinicians and staff members have an unprecedented level of freedom to create and implement the programs that will best serve their patients and communities. We operate with the Core Values of CAPLICO in mind:

* Celebration
* Accountability
* Passion for Learning
* Love One Another
* Intelligent Risk Taking
* Customer Second
* Ownership

We’d love to meet with you if you are passionate about giving exceptional patient care and creating the best Home Health and Hospice agency in the Bay Area!

**Pay Range:** $20 - $28 per hour

The employer for this position is stated in the job posting. The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company of independent operating subsidiaries that provide healthcare services through home health and hospice agencies and senior living communities located throughout the US. Each of these businesses is operated by a separate, independent operating subsidiary that has its own management, employees and assets. More information about The Pennant Group, Inc. is available at http://www.pennantgroup.com.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**: The Case Manager – FCS Specialist, under direct supervision of the Program Manager, or their designee, will be responsible to provide comprehensive intervention and referral services to families who are involved with Child Protective Services (CPS) or families who have been referred to the Human Service Agency’s (HSA) Family and Children’s Services (FCS) Hotline.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**:

* Provide comprehensive services to families experiencing domestic/intimate partner violence, including crisis intervention, safety planning, counseling, case management, home visits, self-sufficiency skill building, and parenting education.
* Conduct individualized risk/lethality assessments.
* Organize and conduct skill building and peer support engagement opportunities to provide general education for clients on domestic/intimate partner violence, positive parenting techniques, understanding the impact of DV on children, building resiliency in children, and related topics.
* Manage client referrals to needed community resources external to and within La Casa's continuum of program services.
* Provide consultation and referral services to the person who perpetrated domestic/intimate partner violence, as appropriate.
* Participate in child, family team meetings and/or case consultation with FSA’s assigned Protective Service Worker (PSW).
* Conduct individual and program consultation to FCS regarding issues related to domestic violence, on a regular and as-needed basis.
* Conduct presentations to FCS staff and the client population related to the services that La Casa will provide.
* Maintain an ongoing knowledge of FCS practices and policies such as the California Child Welfare Core Practice Model.
* Strictly maintain for safekeeping client files and confidential client communications in compliance with grant and/or contract guidelines.
* Execute, maintain, and submit program documentation and data, including evaluations and surveys, in accordance with grant requirements.
* Other duties to specific needs and operations at (DIC) drop-in center for support, as directed.

**Minimum Requirements**:

* BA/BS in Behavioral Sciences (Social Work preferred) and a minimum of 5 years of verifiable case management experience in a relevant and related field, preferred. Or GED/High School diploma or 2-year degree with a minimum of 7 years, verifiable, case management experience in domestic violence, child welfare, housing and homelessness, mental health, substance abuse, and physical illnesses.
* Significant experience providing comprehensive domestic violence intervention and consultation services for families who are involved with or referred to Child Protective Services (CPS).
* Direct experience working collaboratively with public agencies, such as child welfare or other community-based organizations that provide services to the targeted population.
* Strong working knowledge of community resources in the San Francisco-Bay Area.
* Knowledge of counseling techniques, peer counseling models, crisis intervention, social milieu, and group facilitation.
* Understanding of confidentiality and privilege laws.
* Ability to work independently and navigate public transportation to and from a multi-site collaborative.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work as a team member with a strong commitment to collaborative work.
* Ability to approach work with a positive, supportive, and sensitive attitude and demeanor.
* Ability to respond sensitively to women, teens, and their children who may be in crisis and/or seeking support.
* Must be able to fulfill physical requirements of the job (lifting, pushing, pulling, carrying, walking up and down stairs multiple times per day, etc.).
* Understanding of confidentiality and privilege laws governing domestic violence work.
* Verifiable completion of state-mandated 40-hour domestic violence counselor training. Or will be completed during the next scheduled agency 40-hour domestic violence counselor training, including working one overnight shift at La Casa’s emergency shelter.
* Clearance through DOJ Live Scan fingerprinting is required. La Casa de las Madres will consider applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance.
* Valid CA driver's license may be required (depending on the position), clean driving record, and insurable under agency policy.
* TB (Tuberculosis) clearance
* **Bilingual preferred: English/Spanish**

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Company-sponsored 403(b) retirement plan
* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans
* Company-sponsored life and long-term disability insurance
* Generous paid time off, including 13 paid holidays, birthdays, and work anniversaries.

  
Monday - Friday, 8:30 a.m. - 5 p.m.
  
Full-Time 40 hours non-exempt

jobs.title: Senior Learning Program Manager
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**  
This is an exciting fixed-term opportunity for a seasoned L&D Specialist to join the Learning Programs team and support Unity’s cultural transformation. We are looking for someone who can hit the ground running and bring their deep expertise to build and facilitate engaging learning experiences. You will transform technical and behavioral concepts into high-impact, scalable learning that can drive measurable business performance.

**What you'll be doing**

* You will partner with colleagues and business stakeholders to design, create, and execute learning programs, including leadership development, team effectiveness, and interpersonal skills.
* You will leverage your strategic thinking to create scalable learning pathways for our business units, including technical teams.
* You will support the design and build-out of Unity’s Learning Experience Platform (LXP), including creating and updating our content catalog.
* You will lead engaging, interactive workshops and learning sessions (both in-person and virtual) for diverse audiences across multiple locations, from first-time managers to senior executives.

**What we're looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in L&D, with deep expertise in instructional design or organizational development.
* Highly proficient in design tools and learning platforms (video creation [e.g., Synthesia], Rise, Canva, Sana) and a deep understanding of adult learning theories.
* Proven experience building end-to-end learning programs in a corporate setting.
* A strong eye for aesthetics and content design; they should be able to create clean, modern learning and digital assets that look professional.

**Real Estate Operations Manager**

**Plotkowski Deschamps Group | Compass**

**San Francisco, CA | Full-Time, In-Person**

**Salary: $73,000–$90,000 annually**

**About Us**

**The Plotkowski Deschamps Group is an established, high-performing residential real estate team at Compass in San Francisco.**

**Led by Mike Plotkowski and Yulia Deschamps, our team combines extensive San Francisco real estate experience with a commitment to exceptional client service, innovative marketing, and long-term client relationships.**

**We are expanding our team and seeking a highly organized, proactive, and capable Operations Manager to help manage our daily operations and support our continued growth.**

**The Position**

**This is a central role within our business.**

**You’ll work closely with both team leaders, coordinating transactions, listings, marketing, client communications, technology, and administrative operations.**

**We’re looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, creating systems, solving problems, and making sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.**

**The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple priorities, working independently, and helping a busy real estate team operate efficiently.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Operations & Organization**

* **Manage daily operations and administrative workflows.**
* **Coordinate schedules, meetings, appointments, and team activities.**
* **Track projects, deadlines, and outstanding tasks.**
* **Develop and improve organizational systems and procedures.**
* **Support onboarding and integration of new agents.**

**Real Estate Transactions & Listings**

* **Coordinate listing preparation, photography, staging, marketing, and launch schedules.**
* **Track transactions, deadlines, disclosures, and closing activities.**
* **Communicate with clients, agents, vendors, and transaction coordinators.**
* **Maintain accurate transaction and listing records.**

**CRM & Lead Management**

* **Maintain and organize our Follow Up Boss CRM database.**
* **Monitor lead distribution, follow-up activities, and agent responsiveness.**
* **Help implement systems to improve lead conversion and client retention.**
* **Maintain accurate contact records and reporting.**

**Marketing & Client Communications**

* **Coordinate property marketing, email campaigns, and social media.**
* **Assist with marketing materials, presentations, and client communications.**
* **Coordinate with photographers, designers, and marketing vendors.**
* **Help maintain consistent branding and marketing standards.**

**Business Development & Team Support**

* **Assist with recruiting and onboarding new agents.**
* **Help develop systems that support team growth.**
* **Coordinate communication between team members.**
* **Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity.**

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* **Excellent organizational and time-management skills.**
* **Strong written and verbal communication.**
* **Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.**
* **High level of computer proficiency and comfort learning new technology.**
* **Strong attention to detail and follow-through.**
* **Ability to work independently and take initiative.**
* **Professional, personable, and service-oriented approach.**

**Preferred**

* **Experience in residential real estate operations, transaction coordination, or brokerage administration.**
* **Familiarity with Follow Up Boss or similar CRM systems.**
* **Experience with Compass technology and systems.**
* **Experience coordinating real estate listings and transactions.**
* **Familiarity with Canva, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and digital marketing platforms.**
* **Experience supporting multiple executives or a small professional team.**

**We’re looking for someone who:**

* **Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions.**
* **Enjoys creating order and improving systems.**
* **Communicates clearly and follows through consistently.**
* **Is comfortable working directly with business owners.**
* **Can balance detailed administrative work with larger organizational projects.**
* **Enjoys being part of a collaborative, growing business.**

* Paid time off

We are pleased to announce a wonderful opportunity for an **Operations Manager**.

**What will you be doing most days?**

* Coach and support hotel team to effectively manage wages and controllable expenses. Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or team member satisfaction
* Manage costs within the hotel, including supplies, utilities, food and beverage and labor expenses to within budgeted parameters, combining with sales/revenue acumen to deliver an efficient and profitable operation
* Ensure service, technical skills and other training occurs throughout the property to support successful daily operations
* Ensure the cleanliness and functionality of of the rooms and entire building of the hotel.
* Effectively run and oversee the housekeeping department ensuring that it is run and operating effectively on a daily basis
* Review financial reports and statements to understand propertys performance versus budget and expenses. Works to determine areas of concern and develops strategies to improve performance
* Establish and maintains open, collaborative relationships with direct reports and entire team. Ensures direct reports do the same for their team
* Establish a presence with team members on property and actively solicits team member feedback. Utilizes an open door policy and reviews team member engagement results to identify and address team member problems or concerns. Ensures team members are treated fairly and equitably
* Hire team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and leadership to meet the business needs of the operation
* Foster team member commitment to providing exceptional service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and team members
* Demonstrate and communicates drivers of guest satisfaction; ensures core elements of service strategy are in place to produce the desired results
* Serve as a guest advocate for the property. Pulls together resources to resolve guest and operational issues and impact results
* Is highly visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels, and overall satisfaction
* Observe service behaviors of team members and provides feedback to individuals and/or supervisors
* Review comment cards, guest survey results and other data to identify areas of improvement
* Analyze service issues and identifies trends. Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results
* Ensure that building is well maintained and that operational areas have an atmosphere that meets or exceeds guest expectations
* Make decisions and oversee team performance, removes obstacles to success and ensures adequate resources are available to achieve business results
* Inspire and motivate teams to achieve operational excellence
* Ensure policies are administered fairly and consistently and that team member performance is evaluated and recognized where appropriate
* Ensure property meets franchise standards
* Ensure property is a safe and secure facility for guests and team members
* Communicate and ensure execution of hotel emergency procedures

**What are the requirements for this position?**

* You have 3+ years of previous hotel management experience preferred
* Food and Beverage experience preferred
* You have previous hotel leadership experience with proven success in leading teams

You must be able to walk and stand for extended periods of time as the job dictates.

**ABOUT US**  
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. Our impact goes beyond the gym-we support our members' total well-being through coaching, connection, and community. Join us and be part of a team that's changing lives every day!

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Operations Manager partners with the General Manager to run a clean, safe, and welcoming club and deliver an exceptional member experience. This role leads the club's front-line operations team, including Club Attendants, Kids' Club Attendants, and Sales & Service Associates, and is accountable for front desk and member service, Kids' Club, club cleanliness, club retail, and day-to-day club administration. Club Attendants report directly to the Operations Manager, who owns club cleanliness standards and results. The Operations Manager drives club performance in retail, invalid usage, and positive member sentiment. The Operations Manager writes and manages team schedules and is the club's owner for wage-and-hour compliance, ensuring every team member receives compliant meal and rest periods and that timecards are accurate, reviewed, and documented. The extent of hands-on involvement in these duties varies with club size, staffing, and business needs.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Team Leadership & Development**

* Directly supervises Sales & Service Associates, Kids' Club Attendants, and Club Attendants; partners with the General Manager on recruiting, interviewing, and selection.
* Onboards and trains new team members on service standards, club systems, safety procedures, and timekeeping, and ensures required training and certifications are completed and current.
* Coaches team members in the moment, conducts performance conversations and reviews, and recommends pay, promotion, and corrective action to the General Manager.
* Addresses employee relations concerns promptly and fairly, escalating to the General Manager and Human Resources when appropriate.
* Processes new hire paperwork and personnel changes accurately and on time in the company's HR systems.

**Scheduling, Timekeeping & Meal/Rest Compliance**

* Writes and publishes weekly schedules for all direct reports in the workforce management system, aligning coverage to member traffic, labor budget, and applicable state and local scheduling requirements.
* Builds compliant meal and rest periods into every schedule and adjusts coverage throughout the day so breaks are taken on time and are fully relieved.
* Reviews timecards daily for missed, late, short, or interrupted meal and rest periods; resolves exceptions, ensures any required premiums are paid, and confirms documentation and employee attestations are complete.
* Reviews and approves timecard edits and exceptions with proper documentation, and enforces that all time worked is recorded (no off-the-clock work).
* Ensures compliance with minor work-hour restrictions and work permit requirements, where applicable.
* Monitors labor hours and overtime against budget and reports variances and corrective actions to the General Manager.
* Holds the team accountable to scheduling and timekeeping policies through coaching and documentation, and supports meal and rest audits with the General Manager and Human Resources.

**Member Experience & Front Desk**

* Leads front desk operations, including member check-in, guest registration, membership inquiries, account updates, and support for digital check-in and the mobile app.
* Resolves member concerns quickly and professionally, escalating to the General Manager when needed.
* May support membership sales activity, including upgrades, add-ons, and Personal Training referrals, and steps in to assist members and team members on sales matters when needed, as business needs require; this role does not own club sales goals.
* Works front desk shifts as needed to support coverage and model service standards.

**Club Performance & Retail**

* Drives club performance in retail, invalid usage, and positive member sentiment; reviews results with the General Manager and leads the team in action planning to improve them.
* Drives club retail and owns daily retail tasks, including merchandising, product presentation, merchandise transfers, inventory receiving and control, and inventory reports, in accordance with company policy.
* Builds positive member sentiment through visible floor presence, regular member engagement and satisfaction surveys under company guidelines, quick issue resolution, and consistent service standards across the team.

**Kids' Club**

* Oversees Kids' Club operations, ensuring child safety, accurate check-in and check-out, appropriate supervision ratios, cleanliness, and compliance with company policy and applicable state requirements.
* Ensures incidents are documented and escalated according to company procedures and that parents and members are communicated with appropriately.
* Controls child entry and exit, including authorized-pickup verification, and schedules the Kids' Club to meet required supervision ratios.
* Trains and develops Kids' Club Attendants on child-safety procedures and supervises child activity and behavior in the room.
* Flexes coverage between Kids' Club and general club operations throughout the day to meet member demand and required staffing.
* Ensures only team members who have completed the required training and certifications work in the Kids' Club.

jobs.title: Senior Workplace Operations Manager - AI, Technology, and Innovation
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Senior Manager, AI, Technology, and Innovation Solutions is a pivotal leadership role within the Center of Excellence (CoE) for Facilities Management & Engineering. Reporting directly to the Global Director of Facilities Management & Engineering, this position is responsible for driving the research, piloting, and implementation of innovative technology solutions—including artificial intelligence (AI), digital twins, advanced analytics, and customer workplace facing applications—to optimize data governance, facilities operations, sustainability, business outcomes, and workplace experience. The Senior Manager will oversee the full lifecycle of technology innovation: from scouting and evaluating emerging solutions, to managing pilots and scaling successful initiatives, to ensuring robust data collection, analysis, governance, and stakeholder reporting. Additionally, the role includes direct management and development of two Technology Analysts, fostering a high-performance team culture aligned with the CoE’s mission of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

This position requires a unique blend of technical expertise in AI and digital technologies, strategic vision, project management acumen, and strong leadership and communication skills. The Senior Manager will serve as a key interface between technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners, ensuring that technology investments are aligned with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a proven track record in leading technological innovation within complex, global environments, particularly in facilities, operations, or related domains.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Technology Scouting and Solution Evaluation**
* Lead the identification, research, and evaluation of innovative technology solutions (AI applications, IoT, digital twins, predictive analytics, energy management platforms, workplace enhancement, etc.) relevant to facilities management, engineering, workplace experience, and sustainability objectives.
* Conduct comprehensive technology scouting by leveraging patent and literature reviews, market analysis, and benchmarking against industry leaders and peer organizations.
* Assess technical, commercial, legal, environmental, and regulatory suitability of candidate solutions, including risk, scalability, sustainability, and compliance with global standards.
* Develop business cases and recommendations for technology adoption, including cost-benefit analysis, ROI projections, and alignment with strategic priorities.

* **Pilot Program Management and Implementation**
* Design, plan, and execute pilot programs for selected technology solutions, ensuring clear objectives, success metrics, and stakeholder alignment from inception.
* Oversee pilot instrumentation, data collection, and monitoring, ensuring data integrity, privacy, and security throughout the pilot lifecycle.
* Iterate and refine pilot approaches based on real-time feedback, data analysis, and stakeholder input, employing agile methodologies and continuous improvement principles.
* Manage cross-functional teams and external partners during pilot execution, ensuring roles, responsibilities, and deliverables are clearly defined and met.

* **Data Collection, Instrumentation, and Analysis Oversight**
* Establish and oversee robust data collection frameworks for pilots and implementations, ensuring data quality, consistency, and compliance with privacy and security standards.

* Develop and maintain reporting dashboards that provide real-time visibility into key performance indicators (KPIs), pilot outcomes, and business impact.

jobs.title: Talent Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Re:Build**
------------------

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)*

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

Re:Build seeks a hands-on Recruiting Operations Manager to architect and build our AI-enabled talent acquisition function. **Your most important qualification is expert-level experience deploying reliable AI workflows that deliver measurable results, not just using AI tools or creating demonstrations.**

We have budget, internal resources, and support from our Digital Innovation Group. Our technology environment includes but does not have to be limited to **Greenhouse ATS, Clay, LinkedIn Recruiter, Textio, and Criteria.**

**What you get to do**
----------------------

* **AI architecture and delivery:** Own the roadmap from workflow design and prototyping through deployment, adoption, and improvement. Determine when to configure, integrate, buy, or build.
* **Conversational AI:** Deploy hiring-team and candidate-facing agents for requisition intake, process guidance, scheduling, and updates, with authorized system actions and human handoffs.
* **Recruiting infrastructure:** Own system configuration, integrations, data quality, documentation, and vendor performance; reduce administrative work and unnecessary tools.
* **Analytics and planning:** Partner with Finance on workforce planning. Track on-time hiring against fill dates set at requisition opening, recruiter capacity, user experience, costs, and AI impact.
* **Team enablement:** Partner with recruiters, hiring leaders, Digital Innovation, and IT to build practical AI capabilities and turn prototypes into adopted, supported workflows.
* **Responsible deployment:** Establish testing, monitoring, access controls, data protection, accessibility, and fairness safeguards, preserving human accountability for hiring decisions.

**What you bring to the Team**
------------------------------

* Personally delivered multiple AI-enabled workflows into sustained use, including recruiting applications, with measurable results.
* Production experience with conversational agents, trusted knowledge sources, connected systems, multi-step tasks, and human escalation.
* Hands-on fluency with APIs, webhooks, structured data, automation platforms, and AI-assisted development; able to build independently and guide technical partners.
* Strong recruiting operations, analytics, and change-management expertise, with the judgment to distinguish technology needs from process or capacity issues.

**Experience that would be especially valuable**
------------------------------------------------

Experience with our tools, manufacturing, engineering, skilled-trades, or multi-business recruiting is valuable. Exact-tool experience does not replace demonstrated AI implementation expertise.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Less administrative work, better hiring-team and candidate experiences, stronger workforce visibility, and measurable gains in speed, quality, service, and cost, with reliable solutions people use.

**How we will assess your experience**
--------------------------------------

Be prepared to discuss two production deployments: what you personally built, reliability and adoption, measurable impact, and lessons learned. Demonstrated delivery matters more than years using a particular AI product.

  

Compensation (Exempt)

The base salary range for this position is $160k - $190k per year. This range represents the Company's good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

**The BIG payoff**

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

**We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate**

Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufa

jobs.title: Staff Customer Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Staff Customer Operations Manager, you will lead Crusoe's customer feedback ecosystem and use it to shape strategy and operations. You will unify customer and market signals, build a comprehensive view of our customer base, monitor the competitive landscape, and deliver evidence-backed recommendations to executive leadership.

This role connects intelligence to business outcomes. You will track how AI models are evolving and what those shifts mean for GPU demand and our Managed Intelligence offerings, prepare executive customer updates for Cloud Leadership, bring customer evidence into Product and Engineering planning, and build the business case for where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Design and scale the systems that capture, triage, and route customer feedback, including the taxonomy, quality standards, and a central repository of customer evidence
* Own executive update cadences for Cloud Leadership, including the quarterly Voice of Customer executive briefing and Monthly Business Reviews, tracking wins, customer experience signals, and operational updates across the CX team
* Identify where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience based on customer demand, market analysis, and cost to serve
* Advocate for customers in Product and Engineering planning with evidence-based insights, and track the lifecycle of each request from intake through prioritization, delivery, and adoption
* Build the business case for new service offerings and lead their incubation through launch
* Support go-to-market teams with account reviews, customer-specific analysis, and targeted research
* Maintain a comprehensive view of Crusoe's customers, covering segmentation, adoption, and infrastructure footprint, and flag risks such as churn, along with expansion opportunities and behavioral shifts, to account teams
* Monitor competing GPU cloud and inference platforms, including product releases, pricing, and service commitments
* Track AI models across their lifecycle, from frontier and open-weight releases through fine-tuning, serving, and retirement, and map which models and workloads customers train and serve on Crusoe
* Explain what model shifts, such as new architectures, longer context windows, lower-precision formats, and new inference engines, mean for GPU demand, Managed Inference offerings, and account risk

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in customer operations, Voice of Customer, CX or product strategy, or consulting, translating customer feedback into operational changes
* Technical fluency in AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, or developer tooling, with the ability to read technical documentation, support tickets, and release notes
* Ability to separate true technical differentiation from marketing claims
* Strong executive writing skills for memos, briefs, and recommendations
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority
* Comfortable building operating frameworks and processes in ambiguous environments
* Hands-on experience prototyping and operationalizing workflows with AI tools
* Experience at an AI lab, GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or inference platform
* Background in building competitive intelligence or Voice of Customer programs
* Skill in translating technical insights into a business case

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 - $190,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Facilities Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Summary**

The **Senior Facilities Operations Manager** is responsible for the day-to-day facilities' soft services operations across Nextpower’s U.S. offices, ensuring each location is clean, functional, well-supported, and ready for daily business operations.

The role leads site-based office operations personnel and manages the delivery of facilities soft services, including reception and front-of-house operations, janitorial and day porter services, pantry and food services, office supplies, mail and shipping, conference and common-area readiness, waste and recycling, and other day-to-day office services.

This position serves as the primary operational interface between office occupants and the Facilities organization, ensuring facility-related requests and issues are identified, appropriately routed, communicated, and followed through to resolution.

The Senior Facilities Operations Manager works closely with Facilities Managers who retain responsibility for hard facilities and technical building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building controls, infrastructure, etc. This position coordinates the operational impact of that work and ensures continuity of office operations but does not replace the technical responsibilities of the Facilities Managers.

The role partners with Facilities, Real Estate, IT, EHS, Security, Procurement, HR and landlords/property managers among others to maintain consistent facilities service standards across the U.S. portfolio.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in facilities operations, facilities services, corporate office operations, building services, or multi-site facilities environments.
* 5+ years of experience managing Office Managers, facilities coordinators, reception/front-of-house teams, day porters, or other site-based facilities operations personnel.
* Demonstrated experience managing the **day-to-day operation and service delivery** of corporate offices, including reception, janitorial, pantry/food service, office supplies, mail/shipping, conference rooms, common areas, and other facilities soft services.
* Experience establishing and maintaining consistent facilities operating standards, service levels, procedures, and inspection programs across multiple locations.
* Strong experience managing facilities service vendors, contracts, performance, service levels, and corrective actions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage staffing, scheduling, coverage, employee performance, accountability, and development of site operations teams.
* Experience working closely with IT, EHS, HR and Facilities Managers on r hard-facilities issues.
* Ability to recognize facilities issues, determine the appropriate escalation path, coordinate with technical resources, communicate impacts to office occupants, and follow issues through resolution.
* Experience coordinating office moves, restacks, openings, expansions, renovations, furniture changes, and other facilities-related operational changes.
* Experience managing facilities operating budgets, purchase orders, invoices, vendor contracts, forecasts, and operating expenses.
* Strong service orientation combined with the ability to maintain operational standards, accountability, consistency, and cost control.
* Strong communication and relationship-management skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, executives, Facilities Managers, landlords, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
* Highly organized, hands-on, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple locations and competing operational priorities.
Ability to travel regularly among assigned U.S. facilities.  

  

Pay is based on market location and may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education and other job-related reasons. The annual salary range for this position is $150,000.00-$1700,000.00.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

**Role**

We are looking for a Staff Program Manager – Product Operations & NPI. This is a Hybrid (Santa Clara, CA office 3 days a week) role, reporting to the Vice President of Product Operations & NPI in the Product Management department. This role offers a massive opportunity to champion innovation and make a significant mark on the planning and product roadmap at the forefront of the world's cloud security leader by delivering never-before-seen capabilities in threat prevention, visibility, scalability, and business enablement.

**What you'll do (Role Expectations)**

* Leading and orchestrating the execution of multiple product development and launching programs to ensure timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
* Acting as a central liaison for cross-functional alignment, addressing program risks, and resolving bottlenecks proactively to maximize the impact of Zscaler Product Innovation for internal/external stakeholders as well as sales/technical teams.
* Providing consistent updates to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives and milestones.
* Optimizing operational processes to improve collaboration, scalability, and organizational impact
* Fostering a culture of iterative improvement by ensuring feedback is integrated into process refinements

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, or NPI; preferably in SaaS or cybersecurity industries
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex new product introductions and programs via Strong cross-functional coordination skills with exceptional communication.
* An exceptional communicator skilled in aligning cross-functional stakeholders while providing clear updates to senior leadership.

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency.
* A strategic thinker, focused on business outcomes, with a proven ability to orchestrate complex programs from inception to delivery while being an advocate for continuous improvement.
* A proactive problem-solver who identifies and mitigates risks, efficiently resolving bottlenecks to ensure program success while continuously supporting Zscaler Practice.

jobs.title: eCommerce Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The eCommerce Operations Manager is responsible for driving operational metrics for our eCommerce business including Home Delivery, Drive Up & Go and other innovative channels to service our customers in their area of responsibility.

The grocery industry is undergoing dramatic changes driven by customer behavior across the entire lifecycle. Consumers are increasingly discovering new products on social or other digital platforms, shopping for deals on various apps, and increasingly purchasing through E-Commerce or other subscription services. Albertsons Companies has had a legacy of innovation in the grocery eCommerce business for over 15 years. Given the pace of changes in the industry, we are making significant investments in enhancing our digital capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve P&L results and operational metric goals in stores across assigned operating area.
* Lead Home Shopping Department Managers in day-to-day operations to achieve their key metrics of on-time tilling, on-time delivery, picks per hour and out of stocks including delivery via third party logistics partners.
* Lead the field teams through expansion, business and environment changes as needed.
* Review eCommerce goals, metrics and performance with store leadership on a regular basis and partner in growing the eCommerce business and overcoming roadblocks for growth.
* Work with Division Director of Ecommerce on launching innovative strategies and programs for ecommerce.
* Set and maintain high standards of quality, productivity, efficiency and service for our rapidly expanding business.
* Drive a culture of exceptional customer service within the frontline eCommerce staff.
* Ensure operational compliance with ecommerce policies and procedures.
* Manage a team of 50+ employees. Inspire and motivate field staff by providing on-going recognition, coaching and mentoring.

  

**Qualifications**

Education and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in related field or commensurate experience.
* 5+ years of previous retail operations/logistics/supply chain experience, including managing third party providers, preferably in ecommerce.
* Experience working across leadership levels and cross-functional partners.
* Experience in reading and understanding data and translating it to actionable items.

Characteristics and Leadership

* Passionate about customer service. Continuously seek opportunities to improve operational excellence.
* Strong business acumen and ability to analyze business trends and results, and to resolve complex situations.
* Strong ability to lead motivate, inspire, train and coach teams to a common goal of customer service.

Barry’s is the Best Workout in the WorldTM®. Founded in West Hollywood in 1998, it’s the original strength and cardio interval fitness experience that provides an immersive, high-intensity, one-hour workout that’s as effective as it is fun. Our fitness classes alternate between working out with weights and running on a treadmill. Each day focuses on a different muscle group in order to achieve real results and to prevent injuries. Our program is designed to tone muscle and maximize fat loss, while spiking the metabolism for up to 48 hours following the class.

Please be aware that smoking is prohibited in all indoor areas of Barry’s studios and corporate offices.

As a Client Operations Supervisor, you’ll be the first contact for Barry’s, leading best in class Hospitality and execution of daily operations. You will support the Senior/General Manager and Assistant General Manager with key marketing initiatives, team development, upholding brand standards and maintaining all studio facilities. You will lead hospitality, assist clients with class selections, membership queries, Fuel Bar orders and retail. Your passion for customer service and building a strong Barry’s community sets you apart from the rest.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead on duty, ensuring seamless class check-ins, studio opening and closing in accordance with all policies and procedures
* Support management of studio staff on duty
* Develop effective and cooperative relationships with clients/staff
* Support the S/GM and AGM with studio Marketing strategy. This may include:
* Acquisition tactics
* Client and community initiatives
* Studio and team engagement
* Corporate lead generation and outreach
* Assist with fuel bar and retail inventory control and counts
* Partner with S/GM and AGM to support the implementation and execution of all hospitality processes, ensuring all team members have been consistently trained and their skills are continuously developed
* Train and provide ongoing development to team members in service of ensuring a consistent client experience and upholding our mission, vision, values, and hospitality standards
* Oversee milestone, loyalty, and surprise and delight program implementation and execution in studio, celebrating special events with regularity, in accordance with guidelines to drive community and retention

**Manage studio systems:**

* Zendesk
* Brandbot
* Ensure all client matters are properly and swiftly resolved or escalated, and ensure consistent and adequate follow through to all client inquiries
* Assess client needs, maintain quality standards for services, and evaluate client satisfaction while communicating any studio promotions and/or special events
* Lead with prompt and effective internal and external communication

**Maintaining brand standards and all studio facilities responsibilities including but not limited to:**

* Laundry, Red Room maintenance, Locker Room cleaning, overall studio cleanliness
* In partnership with S/GM, AGM or Facilities Lead carry out weekly studio facilities walk-throughs and audits
* Retail and Fuel Bar customer service delivery
* Fuel Bar pre and post class orders
* Merchandising
* Maintaining brand standards
* Identifying opportunities to drive sales and elevate the client experience

**Company Culture Responsibilities:**

* Work to uphold Barry’s community and culture standards, and live the company mission, vision, and values daily.
* Represent the Barry’s brand within the studio and throughout the fitness community.
* Assist in participating in and enhancing the community with your studio and regional teams.

**Required Experience:**

* Strong customer service skills
* Availability to work 5 shifts including weekends and public holidays
* Friendly, outgoing personality and enjoy social interaction
* Exhibits enthusiasm for the studio and for the job
* Must be a patient, courteous listener, able to show empathy
* Responding to clients request with a can-do attitude
* Cooperative manner with an optimistic attitude
* Ability to prioritize and work within a fast-paced environment
* Have an eye for detail and care for the studio’s appearance and cleanliness
* Effective team player
* Maintain a professional appearance and behavior
* Demonstrate excellent communication skills
* Candidates must be at least 18 years or older to apply

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
26 - 26 USD per hour(FiDi)

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

On the Merchant Strategy & Operations team, our mission is to have best-in-class restaurant selection for Consumers and build products and services for our Merchants to grow their businesses profitably on DoorDash. We work on problems ranging from acquiring and onboarding new merchants to building a positive experience and solving pain points for existing merchants, to growing their sales through new products and services.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Merchant Strategy & Operations Associate Manager at DoorDash, you will lead the support experience for our merchants, owning both the strategy & execution of how we serve them once they're live on the platform. You'll be responsible for transforming support into a tech-first, scalable, and seamless experience that drives merchant satisfaction, retention & loyalty.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Strategize** – Build the strategy for helping merchants succeed once they're live on DoorDash by providing fast and seamless solutions when merchants face issues, minimizing operational friction
* **Experiment, Analyze and Implement** – Use data-driven decision-making and sound business judgment to drive go-to-market & execution for new initiatives to help merchants have the best experience on Doordash
* **Influence** – Work cross-functionally with our product, operations, marketing, sales, finance, and analytics teams to land key initiatives

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have completed your Bachelor's degree and have 4-6 years of experience in consulting, strategy, operations, technology, or related experience
* You want to affect change every day and can operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* You love thinking about problems from a first principles approach, and are excited to take action, dig into the details, and try new things in order to create future solutions
* You have experience working on analytical projects (proficiency in SQL is a plus) and are eager to get to the lowest level of detail to pull out valuable insights
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills
* You thrive working in a cross-functional environment, and have had success leading projects across teams
* You're comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and problem-solving. You should be actively exploring and applying AI in your day-to-day work, bringing a beginner's mindset and curiosity as you continuously learn and adapt alongside evolving technology.

  

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15 years of experience in corporate strategy, business operations, product strategy, management consulting, or corporate development within high-tech or infrastructure.
* Experience driving strategy, operations, and multi-year roadmaps.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree, MBA, or other advanced graduate degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 15 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in internal tech or infrastructure strategy and business operations.
* Experience across hyperscale data center, networking, or infrastructure.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

activities

**About the role**
------------------

Muon Space seeks a Senior Program Manager to lead delivery of next-generation satellites for national security missions, including missile warning and tracking. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of payload engineering and rapid-cycle space vehicle development.

The Senior PM is the accountable owner for delivering the program on cost, schedule, and technical performance. You will manage a multi-disciplinary internal team, subcontractors, and a critical-path vendor base for EO/IR payloads, algorithm development, avionics, and space vehicle builds. The role spans the full program lifecycle: design reviews, hardware build, integration and environmental test, launch, and on-orbit operations.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Program Execution**
  + Own the integrated master schedule, cost baseline, and risk register
  + Drive the program through preliminary and critical design reviews, payload and spacecraft integration, environmental test, launch, and on-orbit demonstration, meeting customer milestones and contract deliverables
  + Manage scope, cost, and period of performance against contract milestones and payment events
  + Lead day-to-day execution of the program team to the contract, running the weekly program cadence, internal design reviews, and readiness reviews; provide status and briefing content to the Mission Manager, who is the customer interface
