jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Immersion & Testing
jobs.description:
Meta is building the future of human connection through technology. Our family of apps and services connects billions of people worldwide, empowering them to share what matters most and bringing people closer together. Central to our mission is ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality and user satisfaction.The Product Immersion & Testing Team within Business Product Marketing (BPM) is seeking a Program Manager who is passionate about customer insights, testing, launching, and scaling Meta's newest business and marketing solutions. We accelerate business growth and product development by integrating the voice of the customer into our product marketing flywheel, leveraging insights to drive impactful strategies and outcomes.As an ideal candidate, you have experience navigating ambiguity, defining project scope independently, and aligning stakeholders around a clear plan of action. You have a proven track record of managing complex projects, collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, and leveraging customer insights and data analysis to inform decisions. You have deep experience with Meta's business tools (e.g., Ads Manager), marketing, and measurement, and you have experience distilling complex ideas into actionable insights.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Product Immersion & Testing Responsibilities:**

* Lead Product Immersion & Testing Initiatives: Manage, monitor, and recruit for product tests (alpha, beta, GA) and immersions, driving delivery of multiple projects as the main point of contact for Product, Sales, and Data Science
* Planning and Strategy: Define goals, identify clients, coordinate logistics, and compile key information into briefs for immersion and testing projects
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work extensively with Product Managers, Product Marketing, Data Science, Engineering, and User Research to scope immersion and test design/requirements, manage logistics, and surface insights to influence for product and business outcomes (product changes, roadmap impact)
* Communication: Effectively communicate relevant insights and findings to cross-functional teams, influencing roadmap prioritization and developing solutions to fix problems at scale
* Process Improvement: Inform, influence, and execute new processes based on analysis and impact metrics to improve efficiency and quality of support
* Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and problem-solve issues (bugs, feature requests, product confusions) during testing and immersions, utilizing escalation paths and updating stakeholders
* Travel: Support in-market experiences, with up to 20% travel (including international)

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree in a relevant field (e.g., Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field)
* 4+ years' experience in program/project management, customer service, marketing, user/UX research, operations, or product testing
* 4+ years' experience managing, tracking, and measuring digital marketing campaigns
* Experience initiating and driving projects to completion with minimal guidance
* Experience building relationships with cross-functional teams, delivering impact through communication and influence
* Experience implementing processes/programs to improve product or team performance
* Confidence working independently and leading cross-functional teams
* Understanding of product development, market research, and testing principles
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
* Experience with internal project management tools and escalation paths

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Comfortable dealing with high-pressure, fast-moving, and ambiguous problems
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience working with a broad range of customers or user segments
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with A/B testing
* Experience contributing at both strategic and operational levels

jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence—bringing a broad perspective to problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to team-level goals for cross-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment and the ability to work across a range of variable, often ambiguous risk factors.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering programs for a loosely defined area of work, aligning solutions across teams, and advising cross-functional partners as a subject-matter expert on complex matters in your area.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high-pressure, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful planning, execution, and delivery of projects within budget and on schedule. This role requires strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, as well as a client-centric approach. The Project Manager will work closely with clients, consultants, and internal teams to ensure project objectives are met.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Project Planning & Execution:**
  + Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets.
  + Monitor project progress, identify potential risks and issues, and develop mitigation strategies.
  + Coordinate with clients and consultants to ensure project deliverables are met.
  + Effectively manage project scope and ensure changes are properly documented and approved.
* **Client Management:**
  + Build and maintain strong client relationships.
  + Proactively communicate project status, risks, and issues to clients.
  + Manage client expectations and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.
* **Documentation & Reporting:**
  + Draft and format project documents, including proposals, reports, specifications, and presentations.
  + Ensure all project documentation is accurate, complete, and up-to-date.
  + Prepare and deliver project status reports to clients and internal stakeholders.
* **Project Management Systems:**
  + Manage project tasks, deadlines, and resources within project management systems such as Salesforce, M-Files, Sierra Live, and other internal tools.
  + Ensure accurate and timely updates within project management systems.
* **Internal Coordination:**
  + Coordinate with internal teams (e.g., engineering, consultants, inspectors, marketing) to ensure project deliverables are met.
  + Facilitate communication and collaboration between team members.
* **Overflow Support:**
  + Project Coordinators may assist with overflow work during periods of high demand.
  + Provide support to Project Coordinators with administrative tasks as needed.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in project management, preferably in a professional services environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in managing projects from inception to completion.
* Proficiency in project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), project management software, and CRM systems (Salesforce).
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
* Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy.

jobs.title: Buchanan Y - ASP Program Leader (Part-time and Full-time)
jobs.description:
**Careers by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**  

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),  
o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or  
o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.  

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

**Part-Time and Full-Time opportunities are available for After School Program Dates**:

* San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027
* Marin Sites: August 17, 2026 – June 11, 2027

**Job Responsibilities**

  

**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.
* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.
* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.  
  **Supervision & Safety**
* Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.
* Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline  
  **Record-Keeping & Compliance**
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation  
  **Communication & Engagement**
* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.  
  **Training & Development**
* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

  

**Salary Description**

The After School Program Leader position offers a compensation range of $24.00 – $25.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

**Team Rubicon (TR)** is seeking a Wildfire Mitigation Coordinator (Leased Employee)to join our **Operations** team!

Every day will be a challenge, but every month brings new opportunities for an organization that is quickly becoming a household name in disaster response. This position reports to TR's Wildfire Mitigation Manager and is a hybrid position based out of California.

**Dura****tion**: 12 months (with potential to extend based on business needs)

* Provide geographic training and event support primarily across California as well as supplemental support across other geographic areas, including event creation, input, and coordination with the national training team on event hosting and local requirements
* Work with local teams to build training cadence and volunteer capacity for training opportunities across both geographic areas
* Serve as a local representative for complex national training events, supporting partner management, site identification, logistics, and instructor selection
* Assist in the design and standardization of the wildfire mitigation capability, supporting distribution of training content to local and branch teams

**Experience and Background:**

* Personnel management/training experience, including recruiting, managing, and developing volunteers
* Successful past performance leading or coordinating volunteers highly desired
* Familiarity with wildfire mitigation concepts, tactics, tools, and best practices
* Strong facilitation and public speaking skills; comfortable delivering workshops to varied audiences
* Project management experience

**Special Requirements:**

* Comfortable learning and teaching a structured assessment methodology (e.g., Home Ignition Zone assessments) to volunteer audiences
* Familiarity with the California wildfire mitigation community, public/private/nonprofit partners, across both Northern and Southern California
* Comfortable with frequent travel between Northern and Southern California and to national training events

jobs.description:

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team - like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  
  
**Job ID:** LP\_00027087-2660443

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

**Annual Salary $80,000-$95,000**

ABOUT RITTER CENTER:

For over 40 years, Ritter Center has worked to prevent and resolve homelessness and improve the health, dignity, and well-being of people living in poverty in Marin.

When you join Ritter Center, you join a highly trained staff that combines national clinical best practices with a whole-person care approach to solving each person’s medical and mental health, housing, and food needs.

We are growing to meet the needs of our community. We are looking for staff who are ready for a career with a mission-driven organization, want to be valued, have diverse experience, and have compassion. If this sounds like you, we would love to have you join us!

**All positions at Ritter Center require a background check and Livescan fingerprinting.**

**Please visit our jobs page on our** **website** **for a complete list of our employee benefits.**  
  
Ritter Center is currently recruiting for a Program Manager for our Case Management Department. This full-time, exempt position reports to the Chief of Staff based in San Rafael, CA; the role ***operates out of our main Campus.***

The Case Management Program Manager is an integral role in Ritter Center’s dynamic multidisciplinary team of medical, behavioral health and case management professionals who provide integrated care to our target population. This position reports directly to the Chief of Staff and supervises a team of 7 employees comprised of 3 Case Managers and 3 Patient Navigators and 1 Admin Coordinator. The Program Manager also provides a limited amount of direct client services while managing the work of the team. The services are: Representative Payee, Patient Navigation, Rapid Rehousing funds, Housing First (HBCM), and Custody to Community. This position also serves as the Agency Lead for the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) to ensure timely and accurate data entry across all agency HMIS users. This role leads efforts to triage all drop-in case management and referral services and oversees the coordination of overall client flow.

* Recruit, hire, train and supervise a team of Case Managers and Patient Navigators providing trauma-informed care across a comprehensive and diverse range of programs to ensure effective services and outcomes.

* Meet regularly with Chief of Staff and attend staff meetings and training as scheduled.
* Function as a part of a multidisciplinary team to support the engagement and services for chronically homeless individuals and families with severe and persistent mental illness, physical disabilities, and/or substance use.
* Collaborate with Accounting to verify compliance and accurate tracking of Housing First rental subsidy payments, Rapid Rehousing payments, Rental Assistance payments, Representative Payee accounts management and Social Security reporting.
* Attend and represent Ritter Center at all required County level case conferencing, advocacy, and policy meetings as well as community events and media appearances when requested.
* Oversee accurate record-keeping, documentation, reporting, and retention of client and program records within HMIS and other organizational systems.
* Partner with the Clinical staff to ensure integration of clinical services.
* Supervise and provide strategic direction for case management staff, including leading meetings, performance evaluations, and professional coaching.
* Ensure effective onboarding, performance management, and policy adherence of staff supervised.
* Maintain high staff morale to enable a positive and inclusive culture.
* Work collaboratively to enhance service integration within the organization and non-profit community partners throughout Marin County.

jobs.description:
**Careers by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**  

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),  
o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or  
o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.  

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

After School Program Dates

* San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027
* Marin Sites: August 17, 2026 – June 11, 2027

**Job Responsibilities**

  

**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.
* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.
* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.  
  **Supervision & Safety**
* Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.
* Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline  
  **Record-Keeping & Compliance**
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation  
  **Communication & Engagement**
* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.  
  **Training & Development**
* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

  

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

  

**Salary Description**  
The After School Program Leader position offers a compensation range of $24.00 – $25.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About Amprius**

Amprius Technologies (NYSE: AMPX) is a leader in high-energy, high-power lithium-ion batteries built on silicon anode technology. Our SiCore® and SiMaxx™ cells power unmanned aerial systems, aviation and other applications where weight and energy density matter most. Headquartered in Fremont, California, Amprius designs cells in house and produces them through a global network of contract manufacturing partners.

**The role**

We are looking for a Senior Quality Manager to own quality across Amprius, from incoming materials and contract manufacturers to the cells we ship to customers. You will lead our quality management system, earn and maintain AS9100 certification, and build a supplier and CM quality program that grows with our manufacturing network. Reporting to Managing Director, Operations. Travel up to 20%, including supplier and CM sites in Asia.

**What you will do**

**Quality management system**

* Own the QMS and lead Amprius through AS9100 certification, then maintain it through surveillance audits.
* Set quality policy, objectives and metrics, and report quality performance to leadership.
* Own document control and records requirements, in partnership with the PLM and change control rollout.

**Supplier and CM quality**

* Build the supplier quality program: audits, qualification, PPAP or first-article approval and ongoing monitoring.
* Publish quarterly scorecards (yield, cost, on-time delivery) for every active supplier and CM.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to fast closure and prevent repeat issues.
* Support new CM and second-source qualifications with Supply Chain.

**Cell quality and certification**

* Make sure every shipping product is tested and certified before shipment (UN 38.3, IEC 62133 and customer requirements).
* Lead incoming, in-process and outgoing inspection and test strategy at Fremont and at CMs.
* Lead customer quality: complaints, returns, failure analysis and 8D reports.

Continuous improvement and team

* Run Lean and Six Sigma improvement projects with measurable savings.
* Hire and develop the quality team, including supplier quality engineers assigned to specific CMs and material families.

 **Requirements**

**What you bring**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, materials science or a related technical field.
* 10+ years in quality for manufactured hardware, including 4+ years managing quality teams.
* Has led an organization through AS9100 or ISO 9001 certification as the QMS owner.
* Strong supplier quality background: audits, PPAP or FAI, and CAPA and 8D methods.
* Skilled with core quality tools: FMEA, control plans, SPC and MSA.

**Nice to have**

* Lithium-ion cell or battery quality, including UN 38.3 and IEC 62133 testing.
* Quality oversight of contract manufacturers, especially in Asia.
* ASQ CQE or CQM certification; Six Sigma Black Belt; AS9100 lead auditor.

 **Benefits**  

* Comprehensive compensation package includes base salary. Salary range for this role is X to X. Base salary will be determined based on knowledge, experience, and education.
* Health benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage. Medical options of HMO and PPO plans.
* Employer-funded Health Reimbursement Account (HRA). HSA compatible Medical Plan, FSA Options.
* Pet Health Insurance (dog & cats).
* Traditional and Roth 40l(k) Plans.
* Generous vacation leave starts with 3 weeks annual accrual. 10 paid holidays. Sick time off.
* Cell phone reimbursement.

*Amprius Technologies is committed to promoting an equal employment opportunity workplace environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information (GINA), protected veteran status, or any characteristic protected by law. The Company’s policy is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and administer all employment-related matters based on an individual’s qualifications, abilities, and efforts without regard to protected status.*

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Appointment Type:** This is a Temporary Provisional (TPV) position excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process. It is considered "at will" and shall serve at the discretion of the Department Head. This position will be subject to the Permanent Civil Service examination process at a later date. Successful participation in the Permanent Civil Service examination and selection through an open competitive process is needed in order to be considered for the permanent appointment.

**Application Opening:** October 7, 2026

**Application Deadline:** May close anytime but not before October 22, 2026, at 11:59 PM (PST)

**Compensation Range:** $129,636 - $157,612 annually

**Recruitment ID:** RTF0168077-01142975

**Who We Are**

Through the provision of coordinated, compassionate, and high‐quality services, the Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH) strives to make homelessness in San Francisco rare, brief, and one-time. The Department provides assistance and support to homeless and at‐risk youth, adults and families to prevent imminent episodes of homelessness and end homelessness for people in San Francisco. Services including outreach, homelessness prevention, emergency shelter, drop‐in centers, transitional housing, supportive housing, short‐term rental subsidies, and support services to help people exit homelessness. For more information on the department, please visit our https://hsh.sfgov.org/.

**What We Do**

San Francisco is a pioneer in homeless services and a leader in providing supportive housing as a permanent exit from homelessness. The Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH), founded in 2016, is a national leader in the movement to end homelessness by developing a coordinated, equity-driven, client-focused system of compassionate services while piloting innovative models, and implementing best practice solutions with measurable results.

HSH’s Homelessness Response System (HRS) funds, oversees and implements a system of care that shelters, houses, and serves approximately 15,000 people daily. Major programs include: street outreach and service connection through the Homeless Outreach Team (SFHOT); 3,600 +bed shelter system for transitional age youth, adults and families including shelters for members of the LGBTQ community; rapid rehousing rental subsidies for families, adults, older adults, and transitional aged youth; the Problem Solving and flexible financial assistance programs; and robust supportive housing programs with over 14,500 units which provide housing and services to formerly homeless transitional age youth, individuals, and families.

 **Job Description**

The Continuum of Care (CoC) Program Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the CoC Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) projects that receive rental assistance, supportive services, operating, and administrative budget line items. On an annual basis, the San Francisco Continuum of Care receives over $48 million in funds from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) to administer CoC programs administered by the San Francisco Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing.

The CoC Program Manager supervises staff who work on compliance related to verification of CoC PSH program eligibility, income certifications and recertifications, and the coordination of Housing Quality Standards (HQS) inspections. The position reports to the CoC Program Supervisor and is a member of the Continuum of Care team at HSH.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Supervises and manages the performance of staff
* Under general direction, oversees a portfolio of CoC-program related units and/or services, regularly communicating with stakeholders to provide technical support related to CoC program compliance, contracting, and invoicing.
* Reviews and approves forms and documents related to CoC subsidy billing, such as CoC Rental Assistance Invoice review, Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) Contracts, HAP Contract Amendments, Vacancy Loss Claims, and Property Damage Claims, and security deposits.
* Regularly provides input on program and policy development of CoC team, including the CoC Operations manual, the CoC Subsidy Termination Policy, and the CoC and ESG Desk Guide.
* Proposes and provides solutions to problems that arise within the portfolio, including developing and implementing systems and best practices to support achievement of departmental and grant goals.
* Program manages grant agreements – develops the scope of services and budget for agreements; reviews budget revisions; reviews and submits budget modification requests; and participates in program monitoring.
* Performs analyses on grant utilization and spend down, including other statistical analyses and reports to inform policy and funding decisions to improve on‐going operations of CoC PSH programs and other activities related to the CoC PSH portfolio.
* Reviews invoices and reports in the Contracts Administration, Reporting, and Billing Online (CARBON) system and update CARBON.
* Actively participates in the development, implementation and ongoing operations of the Coordinated Entry (CE) process and the Online Navigation and Entry (ONE) system.
* Addresses backlog issues with verification of CoC eligibility, coordination of HQS inspections, HAP Contracts, etc.
* Assists the CoC Program Supervisor and the CoC Manager in drafting memoranda to CoC grant subrecipients.
* Communicates with CoC tenants on ADA grievances and/or concerns related to CoC program policy.
* Represents the HSH CoC team in projects involving mass relocation of CoC tenants
* Drafts formal correspondence to stakeholders, including contracted providers and tenants.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

Sagetap is a rapidly growing startup changing how enterprise technology executives discover and evaluate software. Our AI-driven platform anonymously connects tech buyers with the industry's most credible technology vendors, helping them cut through the noise and solve their biggest problems.

Backed by investors like NFX Ventures, Uncorrelated Ventures, and Emergent Ventures, we are on a mission to fundamentally change software discovery for senior technology leaders, fostering meaningful connections in a non-sales setting.

We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team that values curiosity, transparency, and impact. If you're energetic, results-oriented, and excited to work in an early-stage environment, come help us shape the future of technology buying at Sagetap!

**The Role**
------------

As a Customer Success Manager at Sagetap, you'll be responsible for building strong relationships with our customers and ensuring they get meaningful value from the Sagetap platform. You'll work closely with senior executives (CEOs, CTOs) and sales / marketing leaders as well as their teams to understand their goals, drive engagement / adoption. You’ll also help them successfully navigate their software discovery and evaluation needs.

This is a highly collaborative, high-ownership role. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers while working closely with Sales, Product and Engineering to communicate customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and help shape the future of the Sagetap experience.

The ideal candidate is curious, highly organized, commercially minded and comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup where priorities evolve quickly. You should enjoy talking to customers, solving problems and taking ownership from initial onboarding through long-term customer success.

***Please note: The first four months will be for parental leave coverage. After you complete the parental leave coverage, there may be an opportunity to support the other side of the marketplace: sages (experts / buyers).***

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own customer relationships from onboarding through ongoing engagement, adoption, renewal, and expansion.

  + The parental leave coverage will involve supporting approximately 70 existing customer relationships.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, technology priorities and software evaluation processes.
* Lead customer onboarding and ensure users understand how to get maximum value from the Sagetap platform.
* Build trusted relationships with senior tech leaders and key stakeholders.
* Proactively monitor customer engagement and identify opportunities to increase adoption, demonstrate value and strengthen relationships.
* Conduct regular customer check-ins, business reviews (QBRs) and strategic conversations to understand evolving needs and priorities.
* Help customers use Sagetap to identify relevant technology solutions and facilitate high-quality connections with vendors.
* Serve as the voice of the customer internally, translating feedback and customer insights into actionable recommendations.
* Identify opportunities for account growth and expansion in partnership with the Sales team.
* Track customer health, engagement and key success metrics and proactively address risks.
* Develop scalable processes, resources and best practices that improve the customer experience as Sagetap grows.
* Work cross-functionally to resolve customer issues and ensure a high-quality experience.

--------------------------

* Experience managing relationships with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business audiences.
* Strong relationship-building skills and a genuine interest in understanding customers' businesses and challenges.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple customer relationships and priorities simultaneously.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset.

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Commercially aware and able to identify opportunities for customer growth and expansion.
* Curious about enterprise technology and software.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You**

* Enjoy working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build processes from the ground up.
* Care deeply about customer outcomes and take personal ownership of delivering them.
* Want to have a visible impact on a growing company rather than simply manage an established book of business.

**Why Join Sagetap?**
---------------------

At Sagetap, you'll have the opportunity to join a small, ambitious team tackling a meaningful problem in enterprise technology. You'll work directly with senior technology leaders, have a significant voice in how we build our customer experience and help shape a rapidly evolving product and company.

If you're excited about helping enterprise technology leaders make better software decisions and want to play a hands-on role in building the future of technology buying, we would love to hear from you.

--------------

Parakeet Health is building the AI-powered operating system for medical practices. Today, healthcare runs on phone calls, faxes, and manual labor, and everyone feels it. Practices burn through staff juggling inbound calls, chasing referrals, and filling last-minute cancellations, while patients sit on hold, wait weeks to hear back, and fall through the cracks when overloaded teams can't keep up.

Our conversational AI agents replace that entire layer: answering patient calls and texts 24/7, booking appointments, processing faxed referrals, and proactively reaching out to patients who need care. The result is practices that run leaner, and patients receive more personalized care whenever they need it.

We’re an ambitious team of seasoned healthcare veterans (One Medical, Commure, R1) and builders (Stripe, Rippling, Google, DoorDash, Microsoft). Our customers include national primary care, specialty, and urgent care medical groups with footprints in all 50 states. We've handled millions of patient interactions to date and are scaling rapidly.

Our customers have grown rapidly, and we’re expanding the Customer Experience team with a second **Customer Success Manager** to ensure our growing client base gets the care they need and sees the value our platform delivers.

jobs.title: Account Manager, SME & Growth
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**About the team**
------------------

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

Airwallex is looking for an Account Manager to manage and grow a substantial portfolio of US-based small and medium customers. You will build trusted relationships with founders, CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders while helping customers maximize the value of Airwallex's global financial platform.

You will use customer insight, product knowledge, and account data to increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and support smooth ongoing operations. This role combines consultative account management, revenue growth, customer advocacy, and cross-functional problem solving across a diverse portfolio of approximately 200 accounts.

We are a hybrid working environment with 3 days per week in the office (SF, NYC).

### **Responsibilities:**

* Identify and convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts by using customer feedback, usage data, and account signals to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.
* Manage a diverse book of approximately 200 US-based accounts, including businesses that operate across multiple countries, and develop a clear understanding of each customer's goals, operating model, and financial workflows.
* Serve as the go-to expert on the Airwallex platform, helping customers maximize the value of core products and adopt additional solutions such as FX, Cards, Online Payments, and other relevant products.
* Build lasting relationships with CFOs, CEOs, founders, and other key decision makers through consultative conversations, regular business reviews, and ongoing engagement focused on customer outcomes.
* Partner with Account Executives, Customer Success, Strategy and Operations, Marketing, Product, Risk, Support, and other internal teams to resolve customer challenges, improve the client experience, and maximize platform utilization.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally by communicating emerging needs, product feedback, operational issues, and opportunities to improve Airwallex's products and processes.

**Who you are**
---------------

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* 4+ years of account management or software sales experience in technology, SaaS, fintech, payments, or a related industry.
* Strong sales skills, including value-based solution selling, commercial judgment, and the ability to navigate complex sales cycles.
* Demonstrated success managing a substantial book of business and driving revenue growth through account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, or product adoption.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to build trust and present effectively to CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders.
* Experience using Salesforce or another CRM, together with spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar tools to organize account data, prioritize opportunities, and manage customer activity.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, API sales, or other technology serving merchants and internationally operating businesses.
* Experience acting as a strategic payments or financial technology advisor, using data and customer insight to explain business value and influence customer decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an organized and methodical approach to managing a high-volume portfolio.
* Proven ability to work with ownership, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including the ability to figure things out and collaborate across functions.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters**
-------------------------------------------------------------

*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Prelim is growing 2-3x annually and our platform powers account opening and onboarding for banks across the country. Our team is at a turning point: the informal systems that got us here won't scale with where we're headed next.

Today, the work of coordinating across teams, tracking delivery, and keeping the company’s operational rhythm falls on the founder — who is also our head of product — and on the leads themselves. That’s not sustainable and we know it.

As our first Business Operations hire, you’ll build the operational infrastructure Prelim runs on. There’s no playbook and no predecessor. You’ll decide what to systematize first, build processes that scale, and manage our two technical account managers.

**What You'll Own**

* **The company operating system.** You'll build and run the lightweight systems that give leadership a weekly view of who's working on what, team load, and delivery risk across product and implementations. When a new bank comes in, you're the person who looks at current allocation, identifies who has capacity, and presents staffing options — not the founder doing it from memory in a Slack DM. You surface stalled projects, overloaded teams, and unanswered customer concerns before they become emergencies.
* **Our technical account management team.** Our two TAMs report to you. You'll hold regular 1:1s, track goals, provide feedback, and develop them. You own their workload and development; the founders retain executive ownership of bank relationships and account strategy.
* **Staffing and project coordination.** When projects need to be reassigned, when someone goes out of office, when a customer issue needs routing to the right lead, you make sure the handoff happens and nothing gets dropped. You maintain the map of who covers what. And when an implementation goes sideways, the lead who owns it runs the recovery. Your job is making sure every client concern has an owner, a plan, and a next check-in date, and that nothing quietly goes dark. If a project stalls or has no owner, you flag it before the client does.
* **Operational rhythm.** Lead syncs have agendas. Cycle kickoffs happen on a schedule. Commitments from meetings get tracked and followed up on. You own the cadence that keeps the company running smoothly.
* **Vendor and logistics management.** You’ll collaborate with People Operations on software contracts, offsites, and team meetups.

**What You** ***Won't*** **Own**

You won't recover client projects yourself — our leads own recovery on their accounts; you own making sure recovery is happening. You won't own client strategy or the executive relationship with our banks — account health, expansion, and voice-of-customer stay with the founder. You're not making product decisions — the founder and product leads own the roadmap, though what you see in the operating data should shape it. And beyond our two TAMs, you're not a people manager — team leads manage their own reports.

**What We're Looking For**

* **4-6 years spanning delivery leadership and business operations**, including a leadership role at a B2B software company or a smaller group in a larger tech company.
* **You've personally done the work at least once.** You've run complex enterprise implementations or owned technical accounts yourself, recently enough that your teams will trust your judgment in an client-facing communications.
* **You're a strong writer and communicator.** The operational documentation, staffing plans, and status rhythms don't exist yet; you'll create them, and they'll only work if they're clear and concise.
* **You're relentlessly organized without being bureaucratic.** You add just enough structure that things don't fall through cracks, and you know the difference between useful process and process for its own sake.
* **You're direct and unintimidated.** You'll tell a lead their team is overloaded, and you'll tell the founder he committed to something we don't have capacity for.

**Nice to Have, Not Required**

* Experience in fintech or selling into banks
* Familiarity with tools like Linear, Notion, Pylon, Mixpanel
* Experience supporting a technical team (engineering, design, implementations)

**What You Won't Find in This Role**

A mature org to administer. You'll work directly with the founder daily, interim structures, and make the org-design decisions a founder has been making from memory. The decisions you make will directly determine the reach and scope of our mission.

**How You'll Know It's Working**

A month in, the founder stops being the person asking "who's covering this." Three months in, there's a weekly load-and-risk snapshot leadership relies on, and every implementation has a clear owner and status. Six months in, a new bank's staffing conversation takes fifteen minutes, client concerns have an owner who isn't the founder.

**About Prelim**

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company retreats. This role would also attend periodic team meetups in NYC and SF.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

Compensation Range: $240K - $260K

jobs.description:
**Location** Virtual, home based office with travel

**Description**

The MCA Connect Project Manager in this role carries a blended portfolio. You will manage day to day support for live Dynamics 365 clients under Managed Services (MgS), manage the discrete enhancement and new functionality work those same clients buy, and direct one or more full life-cycle Dynamics 365 implementations from diagnosis through go-live and transition into support.

  

These three types of work are genuinely different disciplines.

* MgS live support is a queue to be managed against service commitments.
* New functionality and enhancement work is a series of small, fixed-scope projects that must be estimated, scheduled and billed without disturbing the support commitment.
* A full life-cycle implementation is a large, multi-phase program with its own team, budget and executive visibility.

  

The person in this role must be able to manage all three at once, switch cleanly between them, and protect each from the others.

  

You will be supported by a strong delivery team of solution architects, functional and technical consultants, and developers, but you will need a strong background in project management and business process optimization, and either a solid working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform or the capacity to build one quickly. Our projects are strategic investments for our clients. Their successful execution and their ongoing support both require a project manager who is driven, proactive, creative, assertive and relationship oriented.

  

While your primary function is project management, from time to time you may also be asked to assist with other functions including sales and marketing, implementation-related tasks, and general administration.

### **Responsibilities**

The responsibilities below are grouped into the disciplines common to every engagement, then the three work streams in turn, then the financial, communication and practice duties that run across all of them. Each group opens with what the work is and why it matters, followed by the specific tasks the role owns.

**Core project management, all work streams**
---------------------------------------------

A set of project management disciplines applies to every engagement you carry, whatever its size or commercial shape.

* Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, and own deliverables, scope and expectations on each of them.
* Provide leadership to all functional and business areas affected by the work.
* Develop and maintain project plans, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans.
* Drive project decisions and make recommendations to management about schedules, prioritization and resource allocation.
* Work with MCA Connect resource management to secure resources, and resolve the challenges between support needs, enhancement commitments and other milestones.
* Employ project management leading practices as provided by PMI and MCA Connect delivery standards.
* Drive client satisfaction across the portfolio and own the health relationship of every account you carry.

**MgS live support clients**
----------------------------

For an assigned portfolio of live Dynamics 365 clients, the work is a managed queue rather than a plan: tickets arrive on their own schedule to a support queue, and your job is to see that they are triaged correctly, worked by the right consultant, resolved inside the contracted commitment, and visible to the client throughout. Alongside the queue you monitor consumption against contract in period and raise the conversation about overage or change before the period closes rather than after.

* Own the service relationship for each assigned live client and act as their main point of accountability.
* Manage the client’s service desk tickets: triage, prioritization, assignment, aging, escalation and closure.
* Balance case load across the available consultant pool and keep the queue from concentrating on one person.
* Run regular service reviews covering ticket volumes and trends, consumption against the retainer or hours block, open risks and the forward plan.
* Manage environment optimization and management activities, including release and update readiness for Microsoft's service update cadence, environment refreshes and performance reviews.
* Monitor consumption against contract in period and flag over-consumption and under-consumption early.
* Drive the conversation about overage, carry-over or contract change before the period closes.
* Convert recurring incidents and chronic pain points into problem records, root cause work or scoped enhancement proposals.
* Maintain accurate case records, time capture and status in Symphony so reporting, invoicing and utilization figures reconcile without manual correction.
* Receive projects transitioning in from the implementation team and confirm documentation, environments, known issues and open items all transferred.

**New functionality and enhancement delivery**
----------------------------------------------

Live clients regularly buy work that is not support. Further work could be a customization, implement a new D365 module, an integration change, a business process review, or a training package. Each of these is a small project in its own right. The recurring tension in this stream is resource: enhancement work and the support queue draw on the same consultants, and you are expected to schedule around that rather than let one quietly starve the other.

* Qualify incoming requests, distinguish enhancements from support incidents, and route each to the right resources.
* Coordinate estimation with solution architects and consultants, and produce the scope, effort, schedule and price the client will approve.
* Secure written client approval of scope, cost and schedule before work begins.
* Schedule enhancement work packages against the same resource pool that carries the support

jobs.title: Billing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Billing Operations Manager  
  
GridSource is seeking a Billing Operations Manager to lead the billing analyst team within our Managed Services Division. This role owns the accuracy and timeliness of billing across multiple markets and service lines — FTTx fiber installation, Multi-Dwelling Unit (MDU), and Buried Service Wire (BSW) work — and is responsible for the people, processes, and controls that turn completed field work into correct, on-time invoices. You will lead a team of analysts, coordinate the inputs that drive each billing cycle, and build the process improvements that keep billing clean as the business grows.  
  
What You'll Do  
The Billing Operations Manager sits at the center of how GridSource gets paid. You will manage and develop a team of billing analysts, hold the line on billing accuracy, and keep multiple concurrent work streams moving so that every market bills on time. Just as important, you will improve how the work gets done — strengthening controls, closing gaps, and building repeatable processes — and report clearly and concisely to the EVP and senior leadership on billing status, risks, and results. Success means invoices that are correct the first time, billing cycles that close on schedule, and a team that gets steadily better at both.  

*Team Leadership & Development*

* Lead, develop, and manage the performance of a team of billing analysts working across markets.
* Set clear standards for accuracy, turnaround, and follow-through, and hold the team to them.
* Balance and assign workload so billing deadlines are met without single points of failure.

*Billing Accuracy & Controls*

* Own the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of invoices across FTTx, MDU, and BSW work in multiple markets.
* Reconcile completed field work to billed amounts, and identify and resolve discrepancies before invoices go out.
* Establish and maintain the controls that prevent revenue leakage, missed billing, and avoidable customer disputes.

*Multi-Workstream Coordination & On-Time Delivery*

* Coordinate the inputs that drive each billing cycle — field production data, project records, and rate/contract terms — across teams and markets.
* Keep concurrent billing work streams on schedule so each market closes on time.
* Flag and clear the bottlenecks that threaten a billing deadline.

*Process Improvement & Systems*

* Analyze the current billing process end to end and build improvements that raise both accuracy and speed.
* Design repeatable, documented workflows and controls that scale as markets and volume grow.
* Partner with operations, finance, and systems teams to improve the tools and data behind billing.

*Reporting & Executive Communication*

* Provide succinct, numbers-first reporting on billing status, risks, and results to the EVP and C-suite.
* Surface issues early with a recommended course of action, not just a problem.
* Translate billing detail into the few metrics leadership needs to make decisions.

What You'll Need  

*Core Competencies (Required)*

* Team leadership — a proven ability to lead, develop, and get results from a team.
* Billing accuracy & controls — a track record of owning correct, auditable, on-time billing and the controls behind it.
* Multi-workstream coordination — able to keep several concurrent billing streams and deadlines on track across markets.
* Process improvement & systems thinking — sees how the whole process fits together and builds durable improvements, with a continuous-improvement mindset.
* Executive communication — succinct, numbers-first communication to EVP and C-suite audiences.

*Experience & Logistics*

* Prior experience leading or supervising a team (required).
* Working knowledge of billing for FTTx fiber installation, MDU, and BSW work in a multi-market environment.
* Comfort working across billing/ERP systems and spreadsheets, with strong attention to detail.
* Remote role; must be available during core business hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in telecommunications, broadband, or construction / field-services billing.
* Experience building or overhauling a billing process, not just running one.
* Familiarity with job-costing, rate/contract structures, and production-based billing.
* Experience billing for major carriers or MSOs.
* Familiarity with billing-system implementations or reporting / BI tools.

*Work Environment*

* Fully remote, with required availability during 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time.
* Less than 10% travel.
* Close coordination with the EVP, operations and project teams, and finance across multiple markets.

What We Offer

* Health, vision, and dental insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)

GridSource is a full-service utility contractor specializing in telecommunications and broadband construction, as well as underground construction for the natural gas distribution industry.

**Overview**

Kiona is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead complex business transformation initiatives. In this role, you will drive cross-functional projects that enable operational improvement, organizational change, and measurable business value.
