jobs.title: Infrastructure Program Manager – Energy Efficiency & Consolidation
jobs.description:
**About the client**  
Our client is a global leader in sustainable telecom network solutions, operating in the UK, Ireland, the USA and across Europe, Australia, South Africa and Brazil. They help extend the life of telecom networks through multi-vendor parts sourcing, responsible decommissioning and network engineering, with a strong focus on the circular economy and reducing environmental impact.

**Why this role matters**  
As a key member of the Infrastructure Program team, you'll lead delivery of a large-scale infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program across a complex telecommunications estate.

You'll coordinate infrastructure consolidation, energy-efficiency initiatives, DC power optimization, cooling efficiency, network shutdown and site exits. Your job is to bring multiple technical and operational workstreams together to deliver measurable energy, cost and infrastructure reductions with minimal operational disruption.

You'll be the central program owner, working across Infrastructure, Network Operations, Energy Efficiency, Engineering, Real Estate, Field Operations and external suppliers.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program
* Build and maintain the integrated program roadmap, milestones, dependencies and delivery plans
* Coordinate infrastructure, network, energy, HVAC/cooling, property and field-service workstreams
* Develop and manage site consolidation, infrastructure removal and site-exit plans
* Coordinate DC power and rectifier optimization, replacement, retrofit and consolidation
* Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure power consumption and cooling overhead
* Coordinate network shutdown, migration and legacy equipment decommissioning
* Establish a single, validated site and asset baseline for planning and benefits measurement
* Manage program RAID, governance, budgets, forecasts and supplier performance
* Coordinate internal engineering teams, field resources, OEMs and third-party partners
* Track and report measurable benefits, including energy, infrastructure and operating cost reductions
* Provide clear reporting to senior stakeholders on progress, risks, finances and benefits
* Support business cases for infrastructure replacement, retrofit, reuse and recovery
* Maintain operational controls when working on live telecommunications infrastructure

**What we're looking for**

* Proven experience as a Program Manager or Senior Program Manager delivering complex infrastructure programs
* Background in telecommunications, data centers, critical infrastructure or similar environments
* Experience with large-scale consolidation, decommissioning, transformation or site-exit programs
* Strong understanding of DC power infrastructure and telecom rectifier environments
* Understanding of energy efficiency, power consumption and cooling optimization
* Experience coordinating multi-site field delivery and decommissioning
* Strong program governance, RAID, financial and benefits-management skills
* Strong analytical skills, including asset and site-level data
* Excellent communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders
* Strong commercial and supplier-management experience
* Good understanding of operational risk in live infrastructure environments

**Nice to have**

* Telecom DC power platforms such as Galaxy, Millennium, 596, Lorain, OmniOn/ABB and Vertiv
* HVAC and cooling in telecom or critical environments (EC fans, VFDs, airflow management, setpoint optimization)
* Legacy technology decommissioning, including TDM, voice and DACS
* Asset, inventory and site-management systems
* Energy and facilities data, including PUE and energy-consumption measurement
* Field-service, asset recovery and infrastructure logistics

**Contract details**

* W2 contract
* Remote, US-based, with occasional travel to sites as required
* Must be authorized to work in the US

Pay: From $80.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* How many years have you worked as a Program Manager on infrastructure programs?
* Have you delivered telecom, data center or critical infrastructure decommissioning or consolidation programs? Briefly describe the largest.
* Give an example of a high-pressure situation you managed at a senior level?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Core
jobs.description:
**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Manager, Core**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Director, Professional Services  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Core Implementation Manager (Core IM) is the sole owner of a portfolio of roughly 40+ First Due Core implementations, typically multi-module engagements. These standard and moderately complex projects carry real configuration complexity and frequently include CAD integration and historical data migration, requiring disciplined project management, strong customer command, and the ability to direct several internal specialists toward a single go-live date.

The Core IM owns the customer relationship and every project in the portfolio from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, and is accountable for planned duration, scope, risk, customer communication, and time to value. This is a fully autonomous role: you are self-directed on all delivery decisions inside the signed SOW and involve leadership only on commercial and relationship exceptions. Core delivery runs on a paired model: the Implementation Manager owns the project, the assigned Implementation Consultant owns module configuration and functional product depth, and Technical Services owns integration and data migration execution.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a full portfolio of roughly 40+ concurrent Core implementations from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, consistently holding planned duration below team goal.
* Keep Rocketlane, the system of record, current always (plans, timelines, milestones, task status, owners, and dates) so any colleague can open a project and know exactly where it stands. Complete documentation and exit gates on time, not retroactively.
* Lead customer kickoffs with command: set clear expectations, correct unrealistic assumptions in the room, and close with an agreed action list, owners, and dates. Adapt the agenda to each agency’s politics and readiness based on Discovery.
* Run a progress cadence of at least bi-weekly check-ins on new acquisition projects and monthly on upsells, using each one to find and remove the real blocker rather than read status.
* Tailor each plan to the agency’s operational reality, including shift patterns, governance and approval cycles, budget calendars, and go-live blackout windows. Own multi-module sequencing, phasing, and dependency decisions across the platform.
* Direct and sequence the work of Implementation Consultants, Technical Services, Integrations, Support, and Product without direct authority, securing commitment on dates. Module configuration is owned by the assigned Implementation Consultant.
* Proactively surface product gaps, process gaps, communication silos, and methodology friction to leadership with supporting specifics and a proposed fix, and help own internal improvement efforts.

### **Qualifications:**

* This is a remote role, but the person hired must live in the US.
* 5+ years of experience managing customer-facing SaaS implementations (or 3+ years plus a master’s degree), including a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, including how fire, EMS, or law enforcement agencies operate and how decisions are made inside them.
* Demonstrated ownership of project plans, timelines, risk management, escalation recovery, and scope discipline, including change orders, on projects with multiple internal contributors.
* Proven ability to drive delivery outcomes through matrixed contributors without direct reporting authority.
* Working data literacy: comfortable reading record counts, spotting bad mappings, and assessing integration and migration risk.
* Experience with implementation project management tooling.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.

jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a Clinical Care Coordinator to support patients, families, and care teams through organized, compassionate, and timely coordination of care. This is a fully remote position open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate will help patients navigate appointments, referrals, follow-up care, and communication across providers while maintaining accurate documentation and protecting patient privacy.

This role is well suited for a clinically trained professional who is comfortable working independently, communicating through phone and digital platforms, and balancing multiple patient needs in a fast-moving healthcare environment. Part-time and full-time schedules are available.

Key responsibilities

* Coordinate patient care activities, referrals, appointments, follow-up services, and transitions between care settings.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for patients, caregivers, providers, and internal care teams.
* Conduct outreach to patients to confirm needs, review care plans, identify barriers, and support completion of next steps.
* Review clinical and administrative information to help identify gaps in care, missed follow-ups, or escalating needs.
* Document outreach, care coordination activities, referrals, and outcomes accurately in the EHR or care-management platform.
* Collaborate with physicians, nurses, case managers, social workers, and other members of the care team.
* Support patient education and reinforce care instructions within the scope of training, licensure, and established protocols.
* Escalate urgent, high-risk, or clinically significant concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician or supervisor.
* Track open items and follow through until the appropriate resolution, handoff, or patient connection is completed.
* Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, organizational policies, and applicable federal and state requirements.
* Participate in virtual team meetings, quality-improvement activities, and process updates as needed.

Required qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in clinical care coordination, case management, nursing, patient navigation, utilization management, or a closely related healthcare role.
* RN or comparable healthcare education and experience.
* For roles involving nursing practice, an active, unrestricted RN license in the applicable state(s) is required. Candidates must be able to meet any state-specific licensure requirements associated with their assigned work.
* Experience working with an EHR/EMR, care-management platform, patient portal, or similar healthcare technology.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and empathetically.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently from a home office while remaining responsive and collaborative with a remote team.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and the importance of maintaining confidential patient information.
* Reliable internet connection, private workspace, and ability to use a computer, headset, video-conferencing tools, and common productivity software.

Preferred qualifications

* BSN, MSN, or graduate degree in nursing, social work, public health, healthcare administration, or related field.
* Certifications such as CCM, ACM, CPHQ, or other relevant care management or quality credentials.
* Experience with chronic-care management, behavioral health, transitional care, population health, or value-based care.
* RN, LPN/LVN, or experienced Certified/Registered Medical Assistant, Clinical Care Coordinator – Medicare Care Management (APCM/CCM) - Examples may include an ADN or BSN with an active RN license, or a related degree/credential such as social work, public health, health administration, or allied health with substantial care-coordination experience.
* Experience supporting patients across multiple providers, payers, or healthcare settings.
* Bilingual or multilingual communication skills relevant to the patient population.

Success in this role looks like

* Patients understand their next steps and receive timely follow-ups.
* Referrals, appointments, and care transitions are tracked through completion.
* Documentation is accurate, complete, and entered promptly.
* Care-team members receive clear updates and escalations when needed.
* The coordinator consistently demonstrates empathy, sound judgment, and dependable follow-through.

What we offer

* The flexibility of a fully remote position open across the United States.
* Part-time or full-time scheduling options.
* Meaningful work supporting patients and improving the healthcare experience.
* A collaborative, mission-driven environment focused on thoughtful care coordination and continuous improvement.

How to apply

Please submit a resume and a summary of your care-coordination experience, remote-work experience, and current licensure or relevant healthcare credentials. Include your preferred part-time or full-time schedule and the U.S. state in which you reside.

Equal opportunity and remote-work notes

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Employment is contingent on authorization to work in the United States and, where applicable, verification of required licensure, credentials, and background information. Remote-work eligibility may be subject to state-specific employment, tax, and licensure requirements.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

Working across engineering, clinical, regulatory and program teams, the role applies design controls, risk management and quality-system requirements to ensure patient safety, product quality and compliance. It also supports investigations, CAPAs, audit remediation and continuous improvement while using sound technical judgement to resolve complex quality issues.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Creates and promotes a strong quality culture by driving quality and compliance activities for AI-enabled medical devices, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Responsible for ensuring compliance with the applicable Quality Management System, driving quality objectives and metrics, and supporting effective quality operating mechanisms across the business.

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (OR a high school diploma / GED with at least 10 years of experience.)

* Experience supporting AI or machine learning-enabled medical devices, including considerations related to data quality, model performance, traceability, validation, change control and integration with medical-device platforms.

jobs.description:
**What we are looking for:**

  

**Important:** For this role we are only considering US-based candidates who are able & willing to work from Wednesday to Sunday every week.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Test Manager to lead Quality Assurance for a AAA game development team. You will lead embedded testing teams, and partner with cross-functional leadership to balance quality, schedule, and risk in a complex development environment.

  

**What we will do together:**

  

QA Strategy & Leadership

* Define global QA strategy, test objectives, quality gates, and risk-based testing methodologies for major project milestones.
* Integrate QA into early development planning to ensure quality is a core part of the feature lifecycle rather than just final validation.

  

People Management

* Mentor and develop a high-performing team of QA Leads and testers, fostering a culture of ownership and collaboration.
* Manage both internal and external QA resources effectively to meet project demands.

  

Test Planning & Execution

* Oversee comprehensive test execution across functional, gameplay, performance, stability, multiplayer, and platform certification areas.
* Monitor defect trends and quality risks, ensuring critical issues are prioritized and driven to resolution.

  

Defect & Risk Management

* Analyze defect data to identify systemic quality issues and drive root-cause analysis and preventative initiatives.
* Communicate emerging quality risks and technical assessments clearly to Production and project leadership.

  

Milestone & Release Management

* Establish QA schedules and deliverables for major milestones, providing objective assessments of build stability and release readiness.
* Coordinate final regression and stabilization efforts during high-pressure release periods.

  

Platform Certification

* Lead preparation for first-party certification, coordinating test plans and tracking submission risks to ensure successful launches.

  

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Advocate for quality as the senior QA representative within project leadership, balancing technical standards with production constraints.
* Build strong partnerships across disciplines to establish a shared responsibility for quality across the entire development team.

  

External & Co-Development QA

* Manage external vendors and co-development QA teams, defining expectations and reporting standards to ensure seamless integration with internal strategy.

  

QA Tools, Metrics & Process Improvement

* Implement data-driven reporting and dashboards to track build health, test coverage, and milestone progress.
* Continuously improve QA efficiency through automation, tooling, and process retrospectives.

  

**What you will bring:**

* 7+ years in software QA with 3+ years managing teams in game development.
* Proven track record of shipping at least one major AAA title across the full development lifecycle.
* Expertise in developing test strategies, risk-based testing, and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership.

  

Nice to have

* Experience with Unreal audio features (e.g., Audio Mixer, MetaSounds, Sound Cues, Submixes, Quartz, spatialization plugins).
* Experience with platform-specific audio constraints and certification considerations.
* Experience building editor tools and pipeline automation.
* Experience supporting large-scale content teams and multi-project shared technology.
* Experience with console certification, multiplayer/online services, and live-service operations.
* Familiarity with Jira, TestRail, and technical QA solutions like automation and telemetry.

**Interested… a bit about Escape Velocity:**

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. But that doesn't necessarily make us unique. What does make us special? We value the time, energy, and talent of our players and our colleagues. We want every hour spent developing and playing our games to be an incredibly rewarding and worthwhile use of your time. To that end, we are 'Fully Remote' and support team members nearly anywhere in the world. We prioritize honesty, even when that means sharing bad news. We strive to give everyone autonomy so they can determine how best to work and play, and we care more about what you bring to the game and studio than how many hours you're clocking. We're dedicated to building a culture of play, which not only makes us better game makers, but also strengthens the bonds between us all. We believe in constant improvement across all areas – from the game itself to our production design – and are constantly re-evaluating how we spend our time to ensure that we're not wasting yours and we're all always working on the most important things.

  

**A few benefits you can expect from us:**

* Summer and Winter holidays studio closure (separate to PTO allowance)

jobs.title: Account Manager - US based only
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as an RCM Account Manager. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing client accounts, ensuring accurate and timely billing, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining strong client relationships. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in healthcare billing procedures, exceptional organizational skills, and a dedication to providing exceptional customer service.

### **About Heno INC**

HENO was founded by Jeff Hohman, a software engineer, and Katie Hohman, a physical therapist since 2006 and owner of three private practice clinics in Central Florida. When they opened their first clinic, the husband-and-wife team relied on four to five different software systems to manage their practice. This approach quickly proved inefficient and disorganized.

“For the first six months [using multiple platforms], we had no idea whether we were making or losing money,” Katie explained.

As their operations expanded to additional clinics, managing multiple systems became increasingly challenging. Determined to find a better solution, Jeff and Katie set out to develop a software that would simplify practice management and eliminate the chaos of using fragmented tools.

Drawing on Jeff's expertise in software engineering and Katie's hands-on experience managing clinics, they created HENO — the only EMR built by a physical therapist and private practice owner. This all-in-one platform is designed to save time, reduce costs, and streamline operations. By offering HENO to physical therapy practices everywhere, the Hohmans aim to empower clinicians to focus less on administrative tasks and more on what truly matters — the patient.

### **Description**

**Now Hiring: Medical Billing Account Manager**

**Join a fast-growing health tech company revolutionizing Physical Therapy billing!**

**Are you:**

* Enthusiastic and solution-oriented?
* A master of Physical Therapy Medical Billing?
* Seeking a role with real growth potential?
* Ready to prove your leadership and expertise?
* Ambitious and motivated to take your career to the next level?

If so, HENO may be the perfect fit for you.

**Who is HENO?**

**HENO is a rapidly expanding EMR and billing software platform serving Physical Therapy clinics nationwide. With our client base growing quickly and revenue doubling year-over-year, we’re seeking a talented and driven** **Medical Billing Account Manager** **to help elevate our client service experience and support continued growth.**

**Role Overview:**

**As a Medical Billing Account Manager, you’ll be a critical leader in our billing service division. You will oversee billing team operations, ensure quality and timeliness of service, and act as the main liaison between HENO and our valued PT clinic clients.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Monitor PT clinic billing accounts daily to identify and resolve incomplete or incorrect work.
* Coordinate with onboarding to ensure seamless setup for new clients—ensuring no disruption to their cash flow.
* Maintain consistent communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and resolve issues promptly.
* Supervise daily tasks including claims processing, rejection and denial resolution, payment posting, and patient statement delivery.
* Perform quality checks on billing team outputs and ensure all errors are corrected.
* Develop internal SOPs, guides, and checklists to streamline services.
* Train the billing team on best practices for client communication.
* Analyze reports to identify trends, inefficiencies, or potential problems.
* Provide feedback and feature suggestions to management and the product development team.

**What You Bring:**

  

* 3–5 years’ experience in Physical Therapy Medical Billing.
* 3–5 years’ experience working in a billing service environment.
* Proven experience communicating directly with medical clinic clients.
* Strong skills in managing rejections, denials, and overdue claims.
* Experience acting as a liaison between internal billing staff and clients.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) preferred, but not required.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.

**Why Work With Us?**

**At HENO, we’re committed to creating a culture of excellence, innovation, and growth. You’ll join a team that values transparency, client success, and internal development. If you're ready to take ownership of your work and grow into a leadership role, we want to meet you!**

#### **Salary**

$19 - $21 per hour

jobs.description:
**Position Title**

Capital Planning & Stress Testing Program Manager

**Location**

Nationwide, MI 48098

**Job Summary**

The Capital Planning & Stress Testing Program Manager leads Flagstar’s stress testing and capital planning processes, reporting to the Director of Capital Planning & Stress Testing. This role coordinates cross-functional teams to execute stress test plans, ensure regulatory compliance, and align with capital management policies. Responsibilities include developing and integrating stress testing processes, overseeing documentation, guiding scenario design, and preparing reports for senior management and regulators. The manager ensures that capital planning is effective, meets governance standards, and supports strategic decisions. This role exists to ensure the bank’s capital planning exercises are executed efficiently, meet regulatory expectations, and support sound strategic decision-making.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Program Leadership & Plan Coordination: Leads the bank’s stress testing program, coordinating input from multiple departments to collect and integrate all necessary data and materials. Maintains and updates key capital planning documents (e.g., capital plan narrative, policies, contingency plans) to ensure the stress testing process is cohesive and aligned with business objectives.
* Scenario Design & Challenge Oversight: Leads internal stress test scenarios informed by the bank’s idiosyncratic risks (Risk ID inventory) and evaluates capital adequacy under adverse conditions. Manages review/challenge sessions on forecasted results (e.g., PPNR, credit losses), addressing key assumptions and limitations through sensitivity analysis and appropriate overlays.
* Reporting & Regulatory Submission: Prepares and submits regulatory stress testing reports and the final capital plan document, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Produces clear summaries of stress test results and recommended capital actions for senior management and Board review and performs ad-hoc capital analyses (such as peer comparisons) to support decision-making.
* Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensures the consistency and reliability of stress test results through strong quality controls and data governance. Maintains an inventory of critical capital planning data elements, working with Data Governance to resolve data issues, and verifies adherence to internal risk management standards. Supports and addresses any findings from regulatory, risk, or internal audits and ensures continuous compliance with all relevant policies and regulatory requirements throughout the stress testing cycle.
* Proactively manage examination requests, company resources, program risks, and required deliverables, as well as the day-to-day planning and resource allocation.
* Responsible for talent management functions including: employment, performance evaluations, staff development/training, disciplinary actions, succession planning and ensuring all staff comply with compliance requirements.

**ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Strategic Alignment: Works under the direction of the CPST Director to ensure that stress testing activities support the bank’s strategic goals for capital adequacy and risk management. Provides input to senior leadership on opportunities to improve capital efficiency or risk mitigation based on stress test insights.
* Governance and Policy Adherence: Upholds the governance framework for capital planning. Ensures that all activities follow the approved Capital Planning & Stress Testing policies and the governance standards set by management committees (CMC, ERMC) and the Board. All documentation and processes should withstand regulatory scrutiny and internal audit standards.
* Continuous Improvement: Stays current on evolving regulatory expectations (e.g., Federal Reserve guidance for Category IV banks, Basel capital standards) and industry best practices in stress testing. Recommends and implements enhancements to the stress testing program, such as process improvements, model updates (in partnership with model development teams), and improved coordination mechanisms, to continually strengthen Flagstar’s capital planning capabilities.
* Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
* Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education level required: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics or a related field (or equivalent work experience in a related discipline).

* Minimum experience required: 6+ Years experience in financial risk management, capital planning, or stress testing. Involvement in enterprise stress testing processes or regulatory capital plan preparation.
* Technical Skills: Knowledge of regulatory capital requirements and stress testing frameworks (e.g., DFAST/CCAR, Basel III). Proficiency in financial modeling and scenario analysis; advanced Excel skills.
* Leadership & Communication: Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects or teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial analyses to senior executives. Collaborative team player who can influence and coordinate stakeholders across departments.
* Analytical & Detail-Oriented: High attention to detail and accuracy. Strong analytical problem-solving skills to interpret model results and identify trends or issues. Effective at managing multiple priorities and deadlines, especially during peak stress testing cycles.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Education level preferred: Master's Degree (or Postgraduate equivalent) in Finance, Business Administration (MBA), Economics, or a related field or profe

Job Title: Customer Experience Supervisor  
Supervisor-level, 40 hours/week  
Classification: exempt under FLSA  
Location: 100% Remote  
  
**About**  
CleanChoice Energy, a national renewable energy company that empowers people and businesses to cut emissions and live cleaner, healthier lives, is seeking a Customer Experience Supervisor to join the Customer Experience team. This is a unique opportunity to join a mission driven organization transforming the U.S. electricity market by switching homes and businesses to 100% clean, pollution-free energy.  
  
**Job Description**  
This role will be focused on ensuring the delivery of outstanding customer service through effective leadership, coaching, and supervision of the customer service team. We are looking for someone who has strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations, resolve escalated issues, and implement strategies to enhance the overall customer service experience. The ideal candidate must have proven experience in a customer service supervisory or leadership role within a call center environment. This person will report to the Call Center Manager and will have direct reports.  
**Responsibilities**

* Supervise and lead a team of customer service representatives in a fast-paced call center environment.
* Monitor and manage daily operations to meet or exceed performance targets and service level agreements.
* Provide ongoing coaching, training, and feedback to customer experience specialists to enhance their skills and performance.
* Handle escalated customer issues, demonstrating a commitment to problem resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with other departments to address customer concerns and improve overall service delivery.
* Analyze performance metrics, generate reports, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and quality standards.
* Foster a positive and inclusive work environment that encourages teamwork and professional development.
* Stay informed about industry trends, customer preferences, and best practices to drive innovation in customer service operations.

* Proven experience in a customer service supervisory or leadership role within a call center environment.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions to improve team performance.
* Proficient in using Salesforce (CRM) software and call center technology.
* Demonstrated ability to handle stressful situations with composure and professionalism.

**Travel**

* 100% remote position

**Work Environment**

* 100% remote position

Our mission is to transform the U.S. electricity market by switching homes and businesses to 100% clean, pollution-free energy. We are working toward a world free of catastrophic climate change with pure, clean air and abundant renewable energy by providing renewable energy to everyone everywhere.

Ubeya, huh? The name is inspired by the Japanese concept of the "Great Room", a space where people come together to solve problems and tackle urgent matters. Our team builds technology with real-world impact, tackling complex challenges at scale, and turning ideas into solutions that make a difference for thousands of users worldwide.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
**About One Door**

One Door is a profitable, established enterprise SaaS company whose platform runs merchandising and in-store execution for some of the largest carrier, banking and retail networks in the world. Our customers use One Door to keep hundreds or thousands of physical locations (stores, branches, retail doors) consistent, on-brand and measurable.

**The Role**

You will own a portfolio of our largest customers: national wireless carriers, retail banks and global retailers, with individual accounts worth more than $1M a year. You are accountable for keeping them, growing them, and making sure they get the value they are paying for.

Some of these customers are unhappy today, and we need someone who runs toward that. You will sit across from a frustrated executive, understand what is really going wrong, work out the solution with our technical team, and rebuild the relationship until they see you as a trusted advisor rather than a vendor contact. If you have only ever managed happy accounts, this is not the role for you.

This is a senior, hands-on role reporting to our Chief Customer Officer. You will be the executive relationship owner and the single point of accountability for each account: renewals, expansion, escalations, and the internal follow-through across our product, engineering and delivery teams.

**What You Will Do**

* Own renewal and expansion targets across a named portfolio of enterprise accounts.
* Build and maintain relationships with executive sponsors, operations leaders and day-to-day users at each account.
* Run account plans, executive business reviews and success metrics that show the customer measurable value.
* Take ownership of unhappy and at-risk accounts: get to the root of the problem, agree a recovery plan with the customer, and see it through until trust is rebuilt.
* Scope client needs accurately from what customers tell you, and turn them into clear product requirements documents (PRDs) for our engineering team.
* Work with our Client Solutions Architect to design solutions to customer problems, check technical feasibility, and set realistic expectations on what can be delivered and when.
* Act as a trusted advisor: bring customers ideas on how to get more value from the platform, not just answers to tickets.
* Spot risk early and escalate internally with clear, specific asks.
* Scope and sell expansions, new locations, add-on modules and services through SOWs and change orders.
* Lead renewals end to end, including pricing, procurement and contract terms.
* Keep account health, contacts, renewal dates and forecasts accurate in Salesforce.

**Job Summary**: The Case Manager – FCS Specialist, under direct supervision of the Program Manager, or their designee, will be responsible to provide comprehensive intervention and referral services to families who are involved with Child Protective Services (CPS) or families who have been referred to the Human Service Agency’s (HSA) Family and Children’s Services (FCS) Hotline.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**:

* Provide comprehensive services to families experiencing domestic/intimate partner violence, including crisis intervention, safety planning, counseling, case management, home visits, self-sufficiency skill building, and parenting education.
* Conduct individualized risk/lethality assessments.
* Organize and conduct skill building and peer support engagement opportunities to provide general education for clients on domestic/intimate partner violence, positive parenting techniques, understanding the impact of DV on children, building resiliency in children, and related topics.
* Manage client referrals to needed community resources external to and within La Casa's continuum of program services.
* Provide consultation and referral services to the person who perpetrated domestic/intimate partner violence, as appropriate.
* Participate in child, family team meetings and/or case consultation with FSA’s assigned Protective Service Worker (PSW).
* Conduct individual and program consultation to FCS regarding issues related to domestic violence, on a regular and as-needed basis.
* Conduct presentations to FCS staff and the client population related to the services that La Casa will provide.
* Maintain an ongoing knowledge of FCS practices and policies such as the California Child Welfare Core Practice Model.
* Strictly maintain for safekeeping client files and confidential client communications in compliance with grant and/or contract guidelines.
* Execute, maintain, and submit program documentation and data, including evaluations and surveys, in accordance with grant requirements.
* Other duties to specific needs and operations at (DIC) drop-in center for support, as directed.

**Minimum Requirements**:

* BA/BS in Behavioral Sciences (Social Work preferred) and a minimum of 5 years of verifiable case management experience in a relevant and related field, preferred. Or GED/High School diploma or 2-year degree with a minimum of 7 years, verifiable, case management experience in domestic violence, child welfare, housing and homelessness, mental health, substance abuse, and physical illnesses.
* Significant experience providing comprehensive domestic violence intervention and consultation services for families who are involved with or referred to Child Protective Services (CPS).
* Direct experience working collaboratively with public agencies, such as child welfare or other community-based organizations that provide services to the targeted population.
* Strong working knowledge of community resources in the San Francisco-Bay Area.
* Knowledge of counseling techniques, peer counseling models, crisis intervention, social milieu, and group facilitation.
* Understanding of confidentiality and privilege laws.
* Ability to work independently and navigate public transportation to and from a multi-site collaborative.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work as a team member with a strong commitment to collaborative work.
* Ability to approach work with a positive, supportive, and sensitive attitude and demeanor.
* Ability to respond sensitively to women, teens, and their children who may be in crisis and/or seeking support.
* Must be able to fulfill physical requirements of the job (lifting, pushing, pulling, carrying, walking up and down stairs multiple times per day, etc.).
* Understanding of confidentiality and privilege laws governing domestic violence work.
* Verifiable completion of state-mandated 40-hour domestic violence counselor training. Or will be completed during the next scheduled agency 40-hour domestic violence counselor training, including working one overnight shift at La Casa’s emergency shelter.
* Clearance through DOJ Live Scan fingerprinting is required. La Casa de las Madres will consider applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance.
* Valid CA driver's license may be required (depending on the position), clean driving record, and insurable under agency policy.
* TB (Tuberculosis) clearance
* **Bilingual preferred: English/Spanish**

* Company-sponsored 403(b) retirement plan
* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans
* Company-sponsored life and long-term disability insurance
* Generous paid time off, including 13 paid holidays, birthdays, and work anniversaries.

Full-Time 40 hours non-exempt

**ABOUT US**  
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. Our impact goes beyond the gym-we support our members' total well-being through coaching, connection, and community. Join us and be part of a team that's changing lives every day!

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Operations Manager partners with the General Manager to run a clean, safe, and welcoming club and deliver an exceptional member experience. This role leads the club's front-line operations team, including Club Attendants, Kids' Club Attendants, and Sales & Service Associates, and is accountable for front desk and member service, Kids' Club, club cleanliness, club retail, and day-to-day club administration. The Operations Manager writes and manages team schedules and is the club's owner for wage-and-hour compliance, ensuring every team member receives compliant meal and rest periods and that timecards are accurate, reviewed, and documented. * Coaches team members in the moment, conducts performance conversations and reviews, and recommends pay, promotion, and corrective action to the General Manager.

* Reviews and approves timecard edits and exceptions with proper documentation, and enforces that all time worked is recorded (no off-the-clock work).
* Ensures compliance with minor work-hour restrictions and work permit requirements, where applicable.
* Monitors labor hours and overtime against budget and reports variances and corrective actions to the General Manager.
* Holds the team accountable to scheduling and timekeeping policies through coaching and documentation, and supports meal and rest audits with the General Manager and Human Resources.

**Member Experience & Front Desk**

* Leads front desk operations, including member check-in, guest registration, membership inquiries, account updates, and support for digital check-in and the mobile app.
* Resolves member concerns quickly and professionally, escalating to the General Manager when needed.
* May support membership sales activity, including upgrades, add-ons, and Personal Training referrals, and steps in to assist members and team members on sales matters when needed, as business needs require; this role does not own club sales goals.
* Works front desk shifts as needed to support coverage and model service standards.

**Club Performance & Retail**

* Drives club performance in retail, invalid usage, and positive member sentiment; reviews results with the General Manager and leads the team in action planning to improve them.
* Drives club retail and owns daily retail tasks, including merchandising, product presentation, merchandise transfers, inventory receiving and control, and inventory reports, in accordance with company policy.
* Builds positive member sentiment through visible floor presence, regular member engagement and satisfaction surveys under company guidelines, quick issue resolution, and consistent service standards across the team.

**Kids' Club**

* Oversees Kids' Club operations, ensuring child safety, accurate check-in and check-out, appropriate supervision ratios, cleanliness, and compliance with company policy and applicable state requirements.
* Ensures incidents are documented and escalated according to company procedures and that parents and members are communicated with appropriately.

* Trains and develops Kids' Club Attendants on child-safety procedures and supervises child activity and behavior in the room.

* Ensures only team members who have completed the required training and certifications work in the Kids' Club.

The Senior Manager will oversee the full lifecycle of technology innovation: from scouting and evaluating emerging solutions, to managing pilots and scaling successful initiatives, to ensuring robust data collection, analysis, governance, and stakeholder reporting. new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Missile Warning & Tracking
new_jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

Muon Space seeks a Senior Program Manager to lead delivery of next-generation satellites for national security missions, including missile warning and tracking. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of payload engineering and rapid-cycle space vehicle development.

The Senior PM is the accountable owner for delivering the program on cost, schedule, and technical performance. You will manage a multi-disciplinary internal team, subcontractors, and a critical-path vendor base for EO/IR payloads, algorithm development, avionics, and space vehicle builds. The role spans the full program lifecycle: design reviews, hardware build, integration and environmental test, launch, and on-orbit operations.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Program Execution**
  + Own the integrated master schedule, cost baseline, and risk register
  + Drive the program through preliminary and critical design reviews, payload and spacecraft integration, environmental test, launch, and on-orbit demonstration, meeting customer milestones and contract deliverables
  + Manage scope, cost, and period of performance against contract milestones and payment events
  + Lead day-to-day execution of the program team to the contract, running the weekly program cadence, internal design reviews, and readiness reviews; provide status and briefing content to the Mission Manager, who is the customer interface
  + Own the preparation and quality of contract deliverables, including status reports, design review packages, technical and cost data, test plans, and final reports, for delivery to the customer
  + Partner with the Mission Manager and Muon's Capture and Business Development teams on follow-on strategy
* **Subcontractor and Vendor Management**
  + Manage program subcontracts, including mission data processing and algorithm development
  + Coordinate critical-path vendors for detectors, focal plane arrays, cooler assemblies, and optics across long-lead procurements
  + Keep subcontract scope, cost, and schedule aligned with prime contract commitments
* **Technical Leadership and Risk Management**
  + Partner closely with the lead systems engineer and technical leads (payload design, AI&T, optics, electronics, software, mechanisms, thermal, mission systems) to drive technical decisions
  + Own and actively work the program risk register, including supply chain, integration, launch, and demonstration risks
  + Resolve cross-functional issues quickly and escalate to functional and program leadership when needed
* **Compliance and Reporting**
  + Ensure program execution complies with contract requirements, including U.S.-only performance, ITAR/EAR export controls, technical data rights, security requirements, and CUI handling
  + Coordinate with Contracts and Finance on subcontract changes, invoicing, and program financial reporting

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8+ years of professional experience in program or technical management of complex technical system development, deployment, and operations
* 5+ years of hands-on technical experience, preferably in an engineering or similar capacity, or direct ownership of a hardware development effort through design reviews to a tested product
* Direct experience with space, defense, or aerospace program planning and execution
* Demonstrated experience managing programs with multiple subcontractors and a complex critical-path supply chain
* Experience executing rapid-acquisition or prototype agreements for government customers, with familiarity navigating the government program lifecycle, technical data rights, and contract deliverables
* Active Secret U.S. security clearance
* U.S. citizenship required (Clearance required and program is ITAR-restricted)
* Excellent written communication skills; you will author or approve the program's contract deliverables

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance
* Prior experience on a missile warning, missile tracking, missile defense, or similar space-based infrared program
* Working knowledge of EO/IR sensor architectures, focal plane arrays, and cryocooler integration
* Working knowledge of missile warning data products and techniques for detection and tracking
* Experience managing programs through environmental test campaigns (TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC)
* Experience with launch integration and early on-orbit operations

**Salary**
----------

The salary range for this role is $206,000 - $232,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

**About Muon Space**
--------------------

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

---------------------------

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. AC Martin is an innovative, award-winning architecture and interior design firm with offices located in Los Angeles, Sacramento, and the Bay Area. Our work is a mix of K-12, Community Colleges, Civic/Government, Higher Education, Market Rate Housing, Urban Mixed-Use, Hospitality, Industrial, Planning, and Programming. A Project Manager manages multiple small to medium projects, coordinates all aspects of assigned projects, and estimates the scope of work. Prepares strategic plans for project success. Responsible for the coordination of all project efforts, administrative and technical, to ensure the most efficient and cost-effective execution of assigned projects. Works with the project team and mentors junior staff. May serve as the primary client liaison to bring the schedule, budgets, and scope of work to completion and to the client’s satisfaction. May perform as a project architect. Actively manages client budgets, schedules, and programs; project communications and documentation; and project team assignments. Estimates fees, determine the scope of work and prepares proposals and contracts.

* Prepares strategic plans for project success.
* Responsible for the coordination of all project efforts – administrative and technical – to ensure the most efficient and cost-effective execution of assigned projects.
* May serve as the primary client liaison to ensure the completion of the schedule, budgets, and scope of work to the client’s satisfaction.
* Actively manages client budgets, schedules, and programs; project communications and documentation; office administrative tasks; and project team assignments.
* Estimates fees, determines scope of work, prepares proposals, contracts, and change orders/ASRs with the overview of the project PIC.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

Sagetap is a rapidly growing startup changing how enterprise technology executives discover and evaluate software. Our AI-driven platform anonymously connects tech buyers with the industry's most credible technology vendors, helping them cut through the noise and solve their biggest problems.

Backed by investors like NFX Ventures, Uncorrelated Ventures, and Emergent Ventures, we are on a mission to fundamentally change software discovery for senior technology leaders, fostering meaningful connections in a non-sales setting.

We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team that values curiosity, transparency, and impact. If you're energetic, results-oriented, and excited to work in an early-stage environment, come help us shape the future of technology buying at Sagetap!

**The Role**
------------

As a Customer Success Manager at Sagetap, you'll be responsible for building strong relationships with our customers and ensuring they get meaningful value from the Sagetap platform. You'll work closely with senior executives (CEOs, CTOs) and sales / marketing leaders as well as their teams to understand their goals, drive engagement / adoption. You’ll also help them successfully navigate their software discovery and evaluation needs.

This is a highly collaborative, high-ownership role. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers while working closely with Sales, Product and Engineering to communicate customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and help shape the future of the Sagetap experience.

The ideal candidate is curious, highly organized, commercially minded and comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup where priorities evolve quickly. You should enjoy talking to customers, solving problems and taking ownership from initial onboarding through long-term customer success.

***Please note: The first four months will be for parental leave coverage. After you complete the parental leave coverage, there may be an opportunity to support the other side of the marketplace: sages (experts / buyers).***

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own customer relationships from onboarding through ongoing engagement, adoption, renewal, and expansion.

  + The parental leave coverage will involve supporting approximately 70 existing customer relationships.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, technology priorities and software evaluation processes.
* Lead customer onboarding and ensure users understand how to get maximum value from the Sagetap platform.
* Build trusted relationships with senior tech leaders and key stakeholders.
* Proactively monitor customer engagement and identify opportunities to increase adoption, demonstrate value and strengthen relationships.
* Conduct regular customer check-ins, business reviews (QBRs) and strategic conversations to understand evolving needs and priorities.
* Help customers use Sagetap to identify relevant technology solutions and facilitate high-quality connections with vendors.
* Serve as the voice of the customer internally, translating feedback and customer insights into actionable recommendations.
* Identify opportunities for account growth and expansion in partnership with the Sales team.
* Track customer health, engagement and key success metrics and proactively address risks.
* Develop scalable processes, resources and best practices that improve the customer experience as Sagetap grows.
* Work cross-functionally to resolve customer issues and ensure a high-quality experience.
* Contribute to building the Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, metrics and tooling.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Sales, or another customer-facing role, ideally within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.
* Experience managing relationships with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business audiences.
* Strong relationship-building skills and a genuine interest in understanding customers' businesses and challenges.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple customer relationships and priorities simultaneously.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn customer data and feedback into actionable insights.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Commercially aware and able to identify opportunities for customer growth and expansion.
* Curious about enterprise technology and software.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You**
-------------------------------------

* Love talking to customers and building relationships that go beyond the transactional.
* Are energized by solving complex problems and figuring things out independently.
* Can balance being strategic with getting into the details and doing the work yourself.
* Enjoy working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build processes from the ground up.
* Care deeply about customer outcomes and take personal ownership of delivering them.
* Want to have a visible impact on a growing company rather than simply manage an established book of business.

**Why Join Sagetap?**
---------------------

At Sagetap, you'll have the opportunity to join a small, ambitious team tackling a meaningful problem in enterprise technology. You'll work directly with senior technology leaders, have a significant voice in how we build our customer experience and help shape a rapidly evolving product and company.

If you're excited about helping enterprise technology leaders make better software decisions and want to play a hands-on role in building the future of technology buying, we would love to hear from you.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

new_jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU?**

Box is redefining how enterprises manage and unlock value from their content in an AI-first world. In this role, you will partner with enterprise customers not only to adopt Box, but to transform how work gets done across their organization using content and AI.

You will serve as a strategic advisor and operator, helping customers understand their current content workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and design future-state solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

You will work closely with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to align on priorities, drive change management, and ensure that Box delivers tangible impact.

This role represents the evolution of Customer Success at Box—from driving adoption to driving transformation. The ideal candidate combines customer success, consulting, and solution-oriented thinking—someone who is curious about how businesses operate, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by driving real outcomes.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the post-sales relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, with a focus on driving measurable business outcomes and long-term value realization
* Partner with customers to map and redesign critical workflows
* + Identify and activate AI-powered use cases within these workflows
* Translate customer goals into a clear value hypothesis, success metrics and practical AI solutions
* Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of new workflows and behaviors, including stakeholder alignment, enablement and executive engagement
* Conduct strategic adoption business reviews that focus on outcomes, ROI and future opportunities
* Proactively identify risks and opportunities within accounts, using both qualitative insight and data to guide action
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering and Professional Services to:

* 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer-facing managing a book of business
* Experience working with enterprise customers and engaging with senior stakeholders and executives
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs into practical solutions and business outcomes
* Comfort navigating both technical and business conversations, including discussing integrations, systems, and data flows at a high level
* Solid hands-on experience with modern AI platforms and tools, with enough technical depth to understand, evaluate, and challenge solutions without needing to write production code
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate value clearly and persuasively

Responsibilities:

MV Transportation is seeking a **Call Center Manager** for proposed business to oversee all reservations, scheduling, and dispatching operations. He/she will work closely with MV’s management and supervisor teams to confirm service is high quality. They oversee all customer service activities, monitor call hold times, perform quality assurance reviews of all recordings, and work with reservations, dispatch and scheduling staff to confirm that all call center operations appropriately represent and consistently meet company standards as directed by company’s operating contract.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Appropriately staff the call center.
* Manage and oversee training, scheduling of staff and re-training in any deficient areas the call center staff.
* Monitor and oversee all quality assurance/customer service of all call center staff.
* Oversee and monitor ticket store staff.
* Oversee passenger trip requests manually or through use of automated system to achieve system goals (productivity, on-time performance, efficiency, minimum ride lengths, etc.) and considering operator and vehicle availability and vehicle capacity types.
* Oversee when necessary rescheduling trips when necessary in the event of operator or vehicle shortages and in consideration of project work scheduling policies.
* Be the direct liaison for the call center staff union.
* Act as the direct liaison with the client for the call center and its employees.
* Be “on call” during all hours of the call center operations for issues/concerns.
* Daily/hourly monitor all system efficiencies and make adjustments when needed.
* Work with Payroll Support Manager to handle open enrollment and ongoing benefits for Call Center employees.
* Work with Payroll Support Manager on daily and bi-weekly imputing and paying out of Call Center employees pay.
* Maintain professional demeanor and appearance.
* Maintain attendance within policy.
* Handle multiple tasks accurately and effectively.
* Additional responsibilities, as assigned.
* Direct the day-to-day operation of the client call center and ensure services are delivered in accordance with this Agreement and client's established objectives, standards, and performance requirements.
* Oversee call center functions supporting all rider-facing services provided under this Agreement, including reservations, rider support, demand-response mobility programs, and other services assigned by client.
* Maintain a thorough knowledge of the ADA, applicable FTA requirements, and all client policies, procedures, and operating requirements applicable to call center services.
* Be proficient in call center operations and demonstrate competency in all aspects of the client service necessary to effectively manage reservations, rider  
  communications, and related call center functions.
* Ensure Call Center personnel receive appropriate training and supervision necessary to perform their assigned duties and deliver service that meets or  
  exceeds client's established objectives and standards.
* Monitor call center performance and work with CONTRACTOR staff and subcontractors, as applicable, to identify operational issues, implement improvements, and maintain compliance with client's service standards.
* Attend meetings, presentations, and other events as requested by client.
* Be available during normal business hours and remain reachable outside normal business hours for emergencies through client-approved communication methods.

Qualifications:

**Talent Requirements:**

* A minimum of five (5) years of supervisory experience in ADA complementary paratransit reservations and scheduling, or a combination of ADA complementary paratransit experience and experience in a related field.
* A minimum of three (3) years of experience supervising a call center with twenty (20) or more call center agents.
* Demonstrated managerial, leadership, and training abilities.
* Demonstrated expertise in call center reporting, standard call center performance metrics, statistical analysis, and the use of performance data to evaluate call center operations and individual agent performance.
* High School diploma or equivalent.
* Previous data entry, dispatch, customer service, supervisory and/or operating experience desired but not required.
* Strong customer service skills.
* Data entry experience and general knowledge of windows-based computer operating system and Microsoft Office package.
* Knowledge of service area.
* Ability to read, write and speak clearly the English language – basic knowledge of Spanish may be required depending on contract location and requirements.
* Able to use multi-line phone system and handle multiple tasks concurrently.
* Ability to supervise.
* Ability to work independently and follow directions.
* Ability to adapt and remain flexible in a dynamic environment.

*Starting salary range: $82,000 - $112,000*

The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity and maintain employment statistics on applicants.*

new_jobs.title: D365 Project Manager, Managed Services
new_jobs.description:
**Location** Virtual, home based office with travel

**Description**

The MCA Connect Project Manager in this role carries a blended portfolio. You will manage day to day support for live Dynamics 365 clients under Managed Services (MgS), manage the discrete enhancement and new functionality work those same clients buy, and direct one or more full life-cycle Dynamics 365 implementations from diagnosis through go-live and transition into support.

  

These three types of work are genuinely different disciplines.

* MgS live support is a queue to be managed against service commitments.
* New functionality and enhancement work is a series of small, fixed-scope projects that must be estimated, scheduled and billed without disturbing the support commitment.
* A full life-cycle implementation is a large, multi-phase program with its own team, budget and executive visibility.

  

The person in this role must be able to manage all three at once, switch cleanly between them, and protect each from the others.

  

You will be supported by a strong delivery team of solution architects, functional and technical consultants, and developers, but you will need a strong background in project management and business process optimization, and either a solid working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform or the capacity to build one quickly. Our projects are strategic investments for our clients. Their successful execution and their ongoing support both require a project manager who is driven, proactive, creative, assertive and relationship oriented.

  

While your primary function is project management, from time to time you may also be asked to assist with other functions including sales and marketing, implementation-related tasks, and general administration.

### **Responsibilities**

The responsibilities below are grouped into the disciplines common to every engagement, then the three work streams in turn, then the financial, communication and practice duties that run across all of them. Each group opens with what the work is and why it matters, followed by the specific tasks the role owns.

**Core project management, all work streams**
---------------------------------------------

A set of project management disciplines applies to every engagement you carry, whatever its size or commercial shape.

* Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, and own deliverables, scope and expectations on each of them.
* Provide leadership to all functional and business areas affected by the work.
* Develop and maintain project plans, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans.
* Drive project decisions and make recommendations to management about schedules, prioritization and resource allocation.
* Work with MCA Connect resource management to secure resources, and resolve the challenges between support needs, enhancement commitments and other milestones.
* Employ project management leading practices as provided by PMI and MCA Connect delivery standards.
* Drive client satisfaction across the portfolio and own the health relationship of every account you carry.

**MgS live support clients**
----------------------------

For an assigned portfolio of live Dynamics 365 clients, the work is a managed queue rather than a plan: tickets arrive on their own schedule to a support queue, and your job is to see that they are triaged correctly, worked by the right consultant, resolved inside the contracted commitment, and visible to the client throughout. Alongside the queue you monitor consumption against contract in period and raise the conversation about overage or change before the period closes rather than after.

* Own the service relationship for each assigned live client and act as their main point of accountability.
* Manage the client’s service desk tickets: triage, prioritization, assignment, aging, escalation and closure.
* Balance case load across the available consultant pool and keep the queue from concentrating on one person.
* Run regular service reviews covering ticket volumes and trends, consumption against the retainer or hours block, open risks and the forward plan.
* Manage environment optimization and management activities, including release and update readiness for Microsoft's service update cadence, environment refreshes and performance reviews.
* Monitor consumption against contract in period and flag over-consumption and under-consumption early.
* Drive the conversation about overage, carry-over or contract change before the period closes.
* Convert recurring incidents and chronic pain points into problem records, root cause work or scoped enhancement proposals.
* Maintain accurate case records, time capture and status in Symphony so reporting, invoicing and utilization figures reconcile without manual correction.
* Receive projects transitioning in from the implementation team and confirm documentation, environments, known issues and open items all transferred.

**New functionality and enhancement delivery**
----------------------------------------------

Live clients regularly buy work that is not support. Further work could be a customization, implement a new D365 module, an integration change, a business process review, or a training package. Each of these is a small project in its own right. The recurring tension in this stream is resource: enhancement work and the support queue draw on the same consultants, and you are expected to schedule around that rather than let one quietly starve the other.

* Qualify incoming requests, distinguish enhancements from support incidents, and route each to the right resources.
* Coordinate estimation with solution architects and consultants, and produce the scope, effort, schedule and price the client will approve.
* Secure written client approval of scope, cost and schedule before work begins.
* Schedule enhancement work packages against the same resource pool that carries the support

* Lead, develop, and manage the performance of a team of billing analysts working across markets.

*Reporting & Executive Communication*

* Surface issues early with a recommended course of action, not just a problem.
* Translate billing detail into the few metrics leadership needs to make decisions.

What You'll Need  

*Core Competencies (Required)*

* Team leadership — a proven ability to lead, develop, and get results from a team.
* Billing accuracy & controls — a track record of owning correct, auditable, on-time billing and the controls behind it.
* Multi-workstream coordination — able to keep several concurrent billing streams and deadlines on track across markets.
* Process improvement & systems thinking — sees how the whole process fits together and builds durable improvements, with a continuous-improvement mindset.

*Experience & Logistics*

*Work Environment*
