**About One Door**

One Door is a profitable, established enterprise SaaS company whose platform runs merchandising and in-store execution for some of the largest carrier, banking and retail networks in the world. Our customers use One Door to keep hundreds or thousands of physical locations (stores, branches, retail doors) consistent, on-brand and measurable.

**The Role**

You will own a portfolio of our largest customers: national wireless carriers, retail banks and global retailers, with individual accounts worth more than $1M a year. You are accountable for keeping them, growing them, and making sure they get the value they are paying for.

Some of these customers are unhappy today, and we need someone who runs toward that. You will sit across from a frustrated executive, understand what is really going wrong, work out the solution with our technical team, and rebuild the relationship until they see you as a trusted advisor rather than a vendor contact. If you have only ever managed happy accounts, this is not the role for you.

This is a senior, hands-on role reporting to our Chief Customer Officer. You will be the executive relationship owner and the single point of accountability for each account: renewals, expansion, escalations, and the internal follow-through across our product, engineering and delivery teams.

**What You Will Do**

* Own renewal and expansion targets across a named portfolio of enterprise accounts.
* Build and maintain relationships with executive sponsors, operations leaders and day-to-day users at each account.
* Run account plans, executive business reviews and success metrics that show the customer measurable value.
* Take ownership of unhappy and at-risk accounts: get to the root of the problem, agree a recovery plan with the customer, and see it through until trust is rebuilt.
* Scope client needs accurately from what customers tell you, and turn them into clear product requirements documents (PRDs) for our engineering team.
* Work with our Client Solutions Architect to design solutions to customer problems, check technical feasibility, and set realistic expectations on what can be delivered and when.
* Act as a trusted advisor: bring customers ideas on how to get more value from the platform, not just answers to tickets.
* Spot risk early and escalate internally with clear, specific asks.
* Scope and sell expansions, new locations, add-on modules and services through SOWs and change orders.
* Lead renewals end to end, including pricing, procurement and contract terms.
* Keep account health, contacts, renewal dates and forecasts accurate in Salesforce.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of enterprise account management or strategic customer success in B2B SaaS, owning accounts worth $1M+ a year.
* A documented record of renewal and expansion results (gross and net retention, expansion bookings) against a target.
* A track record of turning around unhappy or at-risk enterprise customers, with specific examples you can walk us through.
* Calm under pressure: you can take a hard escalation call with a senior executive and leave it with a plan they trust.
* Comfort with executive conversations, commercial negotiation and enterprise procurement.
* Enough technical and data fluency to understand reporting, integrations and data-quality problems, and to explain them clearly to a customer.
* Strong written communication: clear status updates, escalation notes and executive summaries.
* Based in the United States, able to work remotely during US Eastern business hours, and travel roughly 30–40% to customer sites and our Dedham, MA office.

**Nice to Have**

* A technical or software background (for example implementation, solutions engineering, support engineering, or a technical degree), or comfort working hands-on with data and SQL.
* Experience managing accounts at national wireless carriers, retail banks or large retailers.
* Background in retail execution, merchandising, store-operations or field-execution software.
* Experience with services-heavy accounts (implementations, SOWs, change orders) alongside the subscription.
* Salesforce, Gainsight or similar tools.

**Compensation & Structure**

* Base salary: $100,000 – $120,000, depending on experience.
* Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off.

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a short note on an enterprise account you saved or grew: what was going wrong, what you did, and what the result was.

One Door, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Tax Preparer/Office Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking at Royal Elite Tax Solutions and detail-oriented Tax Preparer and Office Manager to join our team! In this multifaceted role, you will be responsible for preparing accurate tax returns, ensuring compliance with tax laws, and managing daily office operations. Your expertise in accounting software, tax reporting, and client communication will drive our success. This position offers an exciting opportunity to combine technical tax skills with leadership in a fast-paced environment dedicated to delivering exceptional service to our clients.

**Duties**

* Prepare individual, partnership, and corporate tax returns using advanced tax preparation software and stay current with tax law changes
* Ensure all tax documents are accurate, complete, and submitted timely in compliance with federal and state regulations
* Manage office operations including scheduling appointments, maintaining client records, and overseeing administrative tasks
* Provide excellent customer service by assisting clients with tax questions, document collection, and ongoing support
* Conduct client acquisition efforts through marketing initiatives and outreach to expand our customer base
* Maintain proficiency in financial software such as QuickBooks, Sage, and other accounting tools to support bookkeeping and financial reporting needs
* Collaborate with clients on complex tax issues like partnership taxes, corporate accounting, and financial analysis to optimize their tax positions

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in public accounting or a similar role with a focus on tax preparation and compliance
* Strong knowledge of tax law, individual and corporate tax reporting, and partnership tax expertise
* Proficiency in accounting software including QuickBooks, Sage, and other financial management tools
* Excellent analysis skills combined with attention to detail for accurate math calculations and 10 key typing accuracy
* Exceptional client communication skills to explain complex tax concepts clearly and build lasting relationships
* Ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently while maintaining high-quality work standards
* Experience with bookkeeping, technical accounting practices, and financial concepts is highly desirable

Join us if you’re passionate about helping clients navigate their financial journeys while leading a vibrant office environment! We value energetic professionals eager to grow their expertise in tax preparation, accounting software mastery, and client service excellence.

Pay: From $100.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Enrollment Specialist II

Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

HealthEdge is looking for an Enrollment Specialist II, reporting to the Enrollment Manager. The Enrollment Specialist II is responsible for ensuring accurate enrollment including billing and maintenance of member data by researching and resolving enrollment and billing discrepancies. The role is also responsible for reconciling and correcting enrollment-related issues by building case files that are sent to the CMS Contractor for approval and resolution.

**As an Enrollment Specialist II at HealthEdge, this is your opportunity to**

* Be responsible for preparing, processing, and maintaining enrollment and disenrollment requests
* Be responsible to verify and maintain all applicable eligibility requirements
* Be responsible to review and process CMS transactions
* Be responsible for reviewing Medicaid eligibility and completing verification processes
* Be responsible to resolve enrollment system rejections based on regulatory and client specified guidelines
* Be responsible to reconcile membership reports as required by CMS
* Be accountable to attend and successfully complete the trainings scheduled by the client and employer
* Mentor junior members of the team
* Collaborate with other team members on special projects; special projects can include process documentation development, training, quality reviews for the client(s), or any other project as determined by management
* Establish and maintain an appropriate level of communication with management to address issues and concerns and take preventive measures that ensure case accuracy and quality
* Participate in projects as assigned by management
* Perform other duties as assigned

**You bring:**

* High school degree required
* 3-5 years of professional experience in processing Medicare enrollment transactions
* A thorough understanding of Medicare Advantage products, CMS transaction files, and the corresponding enrollment-related guidelines; Medicaid enrollment experience a plus
* Experience with CMS interfaces and systems for managing the Medicare Advantage enrollment and billing functions
* Ability to analyse enrollment reconciliation data and report SLAs, KPIs, and other operations reports and present findings in a structured way
* Willingness to learn
* Team collaborator
* Strong work ethic

**For this role, we value:**

* The ability to adapt quickly to a challenging environment
* A self-starter and quick learner
* Ability to collaborate

**Geographic Responsibility:** Remote, US

**Type of Employment:** Full-time, permanent

**Work Environment:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

* The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
* May require travel dependent on company needs.

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills* *required**. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990**.* *Candidates may* *be required* *to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.*

*HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women,* *veterans* *and persons with disabilities.*

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Customer Success Specialist**  
The Customer Success Specialist supports a portfolio of customer accounts through onboarding, adoption, and renewal, serving as a day-to-day point of contact. They ensure customers see ELC as an indispensable tool with continued value by presenting webinars, translating new features to suit their needs, and providing post-implementation training. The Specialist handles routine questions or escalates complex issues to the right internal team, seeing things through to resolution. They keep a pulse on their assigned customers, flagging at-risk accounts early to prevent churn. The role works closely with Sales, Support, and Implementation to provide a coordinated customer experience where nothing falls through the cracks.  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES  
  
Customer Success & Retention

* Support a portfolio of customer accounts through onboarding, adoption, and renewal, building day-to-day working relationships with account contacts
* Serve as the first point of contact for assigned accounts, responding to questions and resolving common issues directly
* Triage incoming customer requests, routing them to the right internal team for escalation. Follow up to confirm they are resolved
* Monitor account health and engagement
* Collaborate on renewals with the Account Manager
* Identify at-risk accounts early, flag them, and support recovery efforts

Adoption & Training

* Deliver product onboarding and training aligned to the service level agreement
* Help customers apply the product to their day-to-day workflows and share best practices. Based on their expressed pain points, recommend solutions and give tailored ideas for using new features
* With the Implementation Manager, coordinate internally to ensure a smooth handoff from Implementation to Success

Customer Advocacy and Voice of Customer

* Gather customer feedback and usage trends. Share with Product, Support, and other internal teams
* Represent the customer's perspective in internal discussions about their accounts
* Flag expansion and upsell signals to Sales and connect the customer with the right contact

Customer Operations

* Keep account records, activity notes, and health data current in CRM and customer success tools
* Follow customer success playbooks and contribute ideas for continuous improvement
* Coordinate across Sales, Support, and Implementation to keep account information and next steps aligned

Required Qualifications & Education

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Communication, Business Administration, or a similar field; or an equivalent combination of education and 4 years of relevant experience
* 2–4 years in customer success, account management, customer support, or comparable roles supporting a SaaS product.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work across internal teams
* Well organized, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities at once
* A problem-solver who knows when to resolve an issue directly and when to bring in the right people
* Demonstrated ability to connect customer goals to company opportunity via strategic thinking and internal collaboration
* Experience with a CRM, Salesforce preferred

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in EdTech, higher education, or non-profit
* Familiarity with adult learning or instructional-design principles
* Experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence)

Core Competencies

* Customer focus
* Customer Advocacy
* Problem-solving
* Communication and relationship-building
* Collaboration
* Organization and time management
* Adaptability
* Accountability
* Strategic thinker
* Continuous learning

**The Essentials**

* Fully remote in the USA. We provide all necessary equipment and a monthly tech stipend for your home office
* A global team with local connections. Work with talented Lumiverians worldwide
* Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Lumivero participates in E-Verify. All offers are contingent upon successful confirmation of employment eligibility

**Compensation + Benefits**

* Base salary is $70,000 - $80,000 with eligibility to earn a performance-based annual bonus
* Benefits package including generous company contribution for major medical, dental, and vision insurance with HSA and FSA options available
* Additional insurance coverage including long and short-term disability coverage, life insurance, and voluntary insurance options
* Roth and Traditional 401(k) options with a generous match, vested immediately
* Technology stipend to keep your home office running
* Flexible time off, 11 holidays, and paid sick time
* Company paid parental leave policies

**Who we are**

Lumivero empowers researchers, industry experts, and business leaders to simplify data complexity, find insights, and get clarity through human expertise, trusted data, and intelligent agents. We pair expert-built, rigorous methodology with powerful data analysis and AI-driven workflows so the people making high-stakes calls can make them with confidence.

It's trusted at serious scale. Our solutions include the #1 probabilistic risk software, the #1 QDA software, and the most cited software in their fields. More than 27,000 organizations worldwide rely on Lumivero — including around 90% of the Fortune 100 — across energy, financial services, government, defense, and manufacturing.

This tool analyzes resumes against job requirements to help identify well-suited candidates based on skills, education, and relevant experience. However, human recruiters and hiring managers remain actively involved throughout the process — they review applications, exercise independent judgment, and make all final shortlisting and hiring decisions.*

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst/Business Process Modeler (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring a Business Analyst/Business Process Modeler to support the Department of Veteran Affairs (VA) Office of Information and Technology (OIT). They will be a part of the implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment of an enterprise-class financial and acquisition management system, known as the VA Integrated PPBE and Procurement System (VIPPS) solution. This individual will help translate business needs and existing processes into future-state workflows and implementation-ready requirements for the OneStream platform. This role is a fully remote position within the United States with core hours of operation from Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM ET.

Responsibilities:

* Lead business analysis efforts to translate business needs and existing processes into future-state workflows and implementation-ready requirements for the OneStream platform.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and technical teams to elicit, document, and validate business requirements and process models.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops, storyboarding sessions, and requirements gathering activities to define user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Develop and maintain business process models using BPMN, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and Federal requirements.
* Analyze current-state and future-state business processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and recommending solutions that leverage platform capabilities.
* Support the implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment of the VIPPS solution by providing clear, actionable requirements and process documentation.
* Ensure requirements and process designs adhere to Agile practices and are compatible with SaaS or configurable enterprise platforms.
* Document and communicate business analysis findings, process models, and requirements to project teams and stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of business analysis and process modeling methodologies within the project.
* Ensure all activities comply with Suitability/Public Trust clearance requirements.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* 7+ years of relevant experience performing business analysis, requirements development, and/or business process analysis and modeling, including experience supporting Federal Government programs.
* Prior experience performing requirements analysis and business process modeling in a Federal environment.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, storyboarding, journey mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and current- and future-state process modeling.
* Demonstrated experience developing business process models using BPMN is expected.
* Strong working knowledge of BPMN and Agile practices.
* Understand how to design processes that leverage platform capabilities rather than assume a custom-development approach.
* Ability to learn quickly.
* Experience in budgeting (commitments, obligations, tracking expenditures, etc.).

**Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience supporting SaaS or other configurable enterprise platforms is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Federal financial management, budgeting, PPBE, acquisition, or related financial processes is preferred but not required.
* Prior OneStream experience is beneficial but not required.

Posted Salary Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr.
